name: A Brain's Best Friend
reward_text: Variable XP; Borous will serve as 1 of 3 required "votes" for the peaceful ending of Old World BluesBorous feels guilty about Gabe:; 3 cazador poison glands & nightstalker blood vials every 24 in-game hoursBorous feels reassured about Gabe:; 3 cazador eggs every 24 in-game hours

stages.description: Try to find any trace of Gabe in Higgs Village.
See if you can find more evidence of Gabe in X-8.
Return Gabe's Bowl to Dr. Borous.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: A Brain's Best Friend
Complete Welcome to the Big Empty and speak with Doctor Borous during Picking Your Brains.
Locate and obtain Gabe's bowl behind Borous' former residence, house #103 in Higgs Village.
Reach the X-8 research center and kill the cyberdog, Gabe during X-8: High School Horror!.
Return to Doctor Borous.

Reward: Variable XP; Borous will serve as 1 of 3 required "votes" for the peaceful ending of Old World Blues; Borous feels guilty about Gabe: 3 cazador poison glands & nightstalker blood vials every 24 in-game hours; Borous feels reassured about Gabe: 3 cazador eggs every 24 in-game hours

notes: Completing this quest before the main quest Old World Blues will cause Doctor Borous to speak up in the Courier's defense against Doctor Klein during that quest's peaceful path (choosing the non-skill dialogue option), serving as 1 of the 3 required "votes" to get the Think Tank leader to back down.

The game code contains dialogue suggesting this quest could end positively or negatively depending on whether Gabe dies or not (Borous will give the Courier animal eggs instead of dissected parts, and his dialogue when taking the Courier's side is noble and kind), but this appears to be bugged or dummied out.

A unique miniature-sized deathclaw named Stripe will appear living inside the doghouse in Higgs Village. Letters spelling his name will appear on the doghouse, and the letters from Gabe's name will be scattered on the ground. Despite his size, Stripe has the melee damage and HP of a full sized deathclaw alpha male and will attack on sight, however, he will only pursue the Courier to just near the fountain before running back behind the house. Stripe can also appear after the quest has been completed if the Wild Wasteland trait is acquired through the Sink Auto-Doc.

rules.note: Borous supplies 1 of 3 votes for the peaceful ending

Speak with Daniel and ask Waking Cloud's missing family.
Tell Waking Cloud the truth about her husband's death.
Lie to Waking Cloud about her husband's fate.
Reward: Variable XP
Reward: Variable XP; Karma loss

name: A Final Plan for Esteban
reward_text: Discounted services from Dr. KempGood Karma; OR; 50 caps

stages.description: Private Morales has asked me to find and retrieve the corpse of her dead husband. His body is apparently being used as a lure to draw in NCR troops and slaughter them. Better keep a look out for traps and snipers...
The body is just east of REPCONN HQ and I should carry it to the troopers camped out on the north side of the railroad tracks.
I managed to get Ranger Morales' corpse away from the Fiends. I should return to Pvt. Morales and let her know her husband's body is safe.

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: A Final Plan for Esteban
Reach the concourse at Camp McCarran and speak with Private Christina Morales;; agree to help return her husband Esteban's body to the NCR.
Reach the site of Ranger Morales' corpse near the REPCONN headquarters.
Carry the body to the pair of NCR troopers at the checkpoint slightly northwest.
Return to Pvt. Morales.
Reward: Karma gain; Discounted services from Dr. Kemp.
Reward: 50 caps ; Discounted services from Dr. Kemp

notes: Though both Christina and one of the troopers at the barricade mention the death of Ranger Jackson, there is no reward for returning his body to the troopers; Jackson's body is near the rigged shotgun trap between two nearby buildings (sometimes the body may not spawn).
During the body retrieval, the trooper at the checkpoint will have unique dialogue if one brought the body back and either took significant damage or no damage at all.
Before completing the quest, troopers at Camp McCarran can be heard complaining about the NCR not retrieving the body and how it affects Pvt. Morales.
After completing the quest, Mr. New Vegas can be heard over Radio New Vegas making a report about the heroic deed and Christina Morales' gratitude.
Knocking a Fiend sniper off the roof onto the landmines placed around Ranger Morales' body does not appear to set them off.

source: A Pair of Dead Desperados, I

Reach Primm and enter the Vikki and Vance Casino;; interact with the empty case for Vance's 9mm submachine gun near the car exhibit.
Speak with Primm Slim about the missing weapon;; pass a 50 Science skill check to obtain the Primm Slim corrupted memory block.
Leads to: A Pair of Dead Desperados, II

name: A Pair of Dead Desperados, II
source: A Pair of Dead Desperados, II
reward_text: Vance's 9mm submachine gun

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: A Pair of Dead Desperados, II
Locate the Wins hideout slightly west-northwest of the H&H Tools factory and speak with Sammy and Pauline Wins.
Attack and kill them both.
Pass a 55 Speech skill check to convince Pauline to give up on their plan to rob the Strip;; acquire the safe combination from Sammy.
Retrieve Vance's 9mm submachine gun from the nearby safe.
Reward: Vance's 9mm submachine gun; Kill Sammy & Pauline: Vance's lucky hat & Vikki's bonnet

name: A Team of Moronic Mercenaries
reward_text: Restored access to gambling in the Vikki and Vance Casino (after 73 in-game hours)

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: A Team of Moronic Mercenaries
Complete My Kind of Town in Primm, then wait or sleep for 73 in-game hours.
Reach Primm and enter the Vikki and Vance Casino.
Deal with Layla and her thugs.
Attack and kill them.
Pay them a 100-caps bribe (50 if one has between 50-100 caps) or; pass a 30 Speech skill check to persuade them to leave.
Choose passive dialogue options to talk them into giving up.
Reward: Restored access to gambling in the Vikki and Vance Casino (after 73 in-game hours)
Leads to: Big Winner, Vikki & Vance

notes: If one chooses passive dialogue options, Layla will mention that she and her group of thugs planned to get as many caps as they could and head for New Canaan.
Ending the quest nonviolently will cause loot in the casino to become unowned and looting them will no longer be considered theft, with the exception of the following:
Locked door leading to the secured area
Cash registers (even the empty ones)
Safes in the secured area

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: A Trusted Aide
Complete relevant quests and special actions up to earning a Liked reputation with Caesar's Legion.
Reach Caesar's tent at The Fort and speak with Lucius.
Reward: Caesar's Legion safehouse as player character housing

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: A Valuable Lesson
Enter the vault in the Sunset Sarsaparilla headquarters and find the prize.
Reward: 1600 XP; ~1500 caps; Pew Pew

name: Aba Daba Honeymoon
reward_text: First delivery: Turbo recipe or 250 caps; Second delivery: 150 caps; Third delivery: Khan Trick, 300 caps; Great Khans fame

stages.description: Find Jack and Diane's missing drug runner.
Return to Diane and tell her about Anders.
Deliver drugs to Motor-Runner.
Deliver drugs to Don Hostetler at the Crimson Caravan Company.
Return to Diane for your payment.
Talk to Jack about supplying the Great Khans' chem operation.
Teach Jack new chem recipes.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Aba Daba Honeymoon
Speak with Diane at the Red Rock drug lab.
Reach Cottonwood Cove and rescue Anders.
Return to Diane.
Bring the mildly suspicious package to Don Hostetler at the Crimson Caravan Company or Hostetler home.
Return to Diane.
Wear Great Khans armor or pass a 64 Speech skill check to get past the Fiends.
Bring the highly suspicious package to Motor-Runner in Vault 3.
Return to Diane.
Pass at least three 50 Science and/or one 75 Survival skill check(s) to teach Jack new drug recipes.
Rescue Anders: Turbo recipe or 250 caps.
Crimson Caravan run: 150 caps.
Fiends run: Khan Trick, 300 caps, Great Khans fame; Quest completion

notes: The quest may only show up in the quest log and on-screen after one rescues Anders.

Because of the many bugs associated with this quest, including quest outcomes which conflict with quests in Vault 3 like Bounty Killer and I Love Bananas, it is highly recommended that one does not interact with Motor-Runner prior to starting this quest. When entering the room that Motor-Runner is in for the first time, he will automatically engage in dialogue and this will be the player character's only time to interact with him, as once that conversation is finished he will only respond with generic dialogue. In order to successfully complete this quest, it is recommended to acquire the package from Diane to be delivered to Motor-Runner first, then speaks with Motor-Runner for the first time.
It is possible to fail this quest and still earn enough trust with Jack and Diane to achieve the diplomatic route in Oh My Papa, by simply teaching Jack all of the chems recipes.

Once one gets into Vault 3 safely by wearing Great Khan armor, the Fiends will remain friendly even if they remove their armor. They will remain friendly if the player character leaves and returns to the vault later.

After one enters Vault 3, passes the Speech checks, and delivers the drugs to Motor-Runner, it is possible to kill Motor-Runner after giving him the drugs, but before returning to Jack and Diane without failing the mission. The Fiends within the immediate area will become hostile, but those in the Vault who did not actually see the kill won't turn hostile and will still be passive, provided the initial Speech check at the entrance was successful. It is also possible to kill Motor-Runner with a silent weapon (such as a silenced .22 SMG, which the Fiends in the vault may rarely carry); a suppressed sniper rifle is not fully silent) without any generic Fiends becoming hostile.

If the unmarked quest Bounty Killer is already active and one has talked to Bryce Anders about killing Motor-Runner, then Motor-Runner will initiate combat when the player character enters the room. Wearing Khan faction armor will not prevent this.

rules.note: Works even if Aba Daba Honeymoon is failed

reward_text: Q-35 matter modulator

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: Access Powers
Reach the REPCONN headquarters west-northwest of the 188 Trading Post.
Locate and obtain the corresponding security keycard to open access to each level of the HQ building.
Open access to the sealed room on the first floor.
Reward: Q-35 matter modulator

name: Ain't That a Kick in the Head
source: Ain't That a Kick in the Head (quest)
reward_text: Vault 21 jumpsuit; Pip-Boy 3000; 18 caps; 9mm pistol (default or with Guns tagged); Laser pistol (with Energy Weapons tagged); Straight razor (with Melee weapons tagged); Boxing gloves (with Unarmed tagged); Dynamite (with Explosives tagged); 6 bobby pins (12 with Lockpick tagged)

stages.description: Walk to the Vit-o-matic Vigor Tester.
Use the Vit-o-matic Vigor Tester.
Sit down on the couch in Doc Mitchell's living room.
Follow Doc Mitchell to the exit.

walkthrough.text: Tutorial Quest: Ain't That A Kick in the Head
Give Doc Mitchell your name.
Decide your character appearance.
Decide your SPECIAL attributes.
Decide your Tag skills and traits.
Talk to Doc Mitchell in his house.
Reward: Vault 21 jumpsuit; Pip-Boy 3000; Various loot (depending on chosen Tag skills); Game beginning
Leads to: Back in the Saddle

notes: Once Doc Mitchell finishes his ending dialogue, the game will offer the option to play the game in Hardcore mode. The reward is an achievement/trophy. There is no in-game reward for completing the game in Hardcore mode.

If one has a 30 Speech skill level and a Medicine skill level lower than 30, it is possible to pass a total of 3 Speech checks receiving a total of 8 Stimpaks and 90 experience points by talking to Doc Mitchell again. After passing the first Speech check, use a Today's Physician to raise the Medicine skill to 30. Then, talk with Doc Mitchell again to pass the Medicine check, followed by another 30 Speech skill check.

Alternatively, if the Speech and Medicine skills both exceed 30, then Medicine can be lowered below 30 (e.g. with the alcoholic drinks usually present in Doc's refrigerator), then the Speech check passed, and then once the alcohol wears off the Medicine and second Speech check can be passed before leaving the house.
None of the items in Doc Mitchell's house during and after the quest are marked as owned by him, allowing them to be stolen without incurring Karma loss.
No matter what name is chosen when asked by Doc Mitchell, he will always reply with "Huh. Can't say it's what I'd have picked for you. But if that's your name, that's your name."

name: All Fired Up!
reward_text: All-American; Pulse gun (optional); Various weapons & ammunition

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: All Fired Up!
Reach Vault 34;; go east of the east pump station and slightly north of Cannibal Johnson's cave.
Locate the terminal passwords for the Vault's security and utility systems.
Hack the corresponding Very Hard-locked security and utility terminals.
Open the Vault's armory.
Reward: All-American marksman carbine; Pulse gun (optional); Various weapons & ammunition

name: All My Friends Have Off Switches
source: All My Friends Have Off Switches
reward_text: Variable XP; Sink appliances and their unique services available; Making Friends achievement/trophy

stages.description: Go to The Sink and install the Central Intelligence Unit.
Find the missing personality modules
Find the missing modules for the Sink, Auto-Doc, and the Biological Research Station.
Find the first set of personality modules for The Sink
Find the missing modules for the Light Switches and the Jukebox.
Find the second set of personality modules for The Sink
Find the missing modules for the Toaster, Muggy and the Book Chute.
Find the third set of personality modules for The Sink
Install the personality modules in The Sink.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: All My Friends Have Off Switches
Complete Welcome to the Big Empty to obtain the personality module for the Sink Central Intelligence Unit,; then go to the Sink and reactivate it.
Find the missing personality modules for other Sink appliances around Big MT (see below).
Return them to the Sink to activate its appliances.
Reward: Variable XP; Sink appliances and their unique services available; Making Friends achievement/trophy
Leads to: Influencing People

notes: Once installed (and one refrains from having the SCIU turn them off), many of the automated personalities will speak at random whenever entering the Sink. For instance, the Auto-Doc sometimes talks in his "sleep," and Muggy complains about a song he hates singing.

All of the automated personalities' locations within the Sink have a white hexagon painted on the floor in front of them. Muggy, the mini Securitron in the master bedroom, is the only one who moves from his original position and wanders around the rooms of the Sink.

name: All or Nothing
reward_text: Game completion; Blade of the East (optional); Legate's helmet (optional); General Oliver's uniform (optional); End Game

Activate the eastern power plant to power the Securitron Army.
Exit out to the east side of the Dam.
Head to the Legate's camp and deal with the Legate and Caesar's Legion.
Deal with General Oliver and the NCR.
Return to Mr. House and inform him of the victory.

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: All or Nothing
Enter the Hoover Dam offices.
Install the override to give Mr. House control of the dam's systems.
Reach Hoover Dam Power Plant 1 and power on the East Power Plant.
Reach the Legate's camp on the eastern side of the dam.
Deal with Legate Lanius.
Fight and kill Lanius.
Pass a skill check of 100 Speech or 100 Barter to convince Lanius to retreat.
Deal with General Oliver.
Fight and kill General Oliver.
Pass a skill check of 100 Science, Barter or Speech to convince Oliver to retreat.
Speak with Mr. House
Reward: Game completion; Achievement/trophy

name: An Ear to the Ground
reward_text: NCR fame100 caps + 6 beer; OR; Karma gain

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: An Ear to the Ground
Reach Camp Forlorn Hope and enter the barracks to speak with Private Sexton;; agree to help with the contest to boost the camp's morale.
Obtain Legion ears from deceased Caesar's Legion members and return them to Private Sexton.
Reward: NCR fame100 caps + 6 beer; OR; Karma gain

notes: Due to Sexton not being a marked target during We Are Legion, it is possible to continue bringing him Legion ears even after killing off the camp's officers.

Various Legionaries – including those at the Fort, the Legate's camp, members of Legionary assassin squads, and the three waves that attack Bitter Springs during I Forgot to Remember to Forget – do not drop ears upon death during this quest. For this reason, it is advisable to speak to Pvt. Sexton and start this quest prior to completing Restoring Hope, in order to maximize one's "ear harvesting" opportunities.

The number of ears collected will be represented as tally marks in the mess hall to Sexton's right, beneath a bull with the initials of Caesar's Legion above it, but only in multiples of 5 (e.g. at 11-14 ears, only 10 marks are shown). These marks will stop after turning in the maximum 30 ears, no matter how many have been turned in at once to reach that threshold.

name: Andy and Charlie
reward_text: Novac fame; NCR fame; Ranger Takedown; 100 caps; OR; Novac fame; NCR fame; 200 caps

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: Andy and Charlie
Reach Novac and speak with Ranger Andy in his bungalow near the Dino Dee-lite Motel;; agree to check up on his fellow Rangers at the nearby Ranger Station Charlie.
(Optional) Pass a 30 Speech skill check to reassure Andy about his capabilities despite his injury.
Reach Ranger Station Charlie southwest of Novac and enter the main building.
Return to Andy.
(Optional) Pass a 60 Speech check to lie about the rangers to Andy.
Reward: Novac fame, NCR fame, Ranger Takedown, 100 caps; OR; Novac fame, NCR fame, 200 caps

notes: If one ends the dialogue with Ranger Andy via the 30 Speech check, thus learning the Ranger Takedown move, the quest will not start. This is because the quest is connected to the "Goodbye." dialogue-ending option, which is skipped in this case.

If the player character has progressed into the later part of the story, they can visit Ranger Station Charlie as part of the quest Return to Sender and speak to Ranger Andy after finding the station wiped out. If one has not progressed far enough, the station will still be occupied and there will be no option to confirm this with Andy. Upon receiving the task to check on the station, the script that wipes out the station will be triggered when next entering the station interior.

When inside the station with the dead NCR troopers, there is a frag mine under each of the two bodies in the first room and a tripwire behind a closed door, linked to a rigged shotgun beneath a bunkbed, rigged to cause a bottlecap mine to detonate two explosive canisters.

name: Ant Misbehavin'
reward_text: 300 XP; Boomers fame; Thump-Thump (optional)

stages.description: Restart the 2 array generators, then reset the main power breaker.
Kill all ants in the generator room.
(Optional) Loyal may have something to help with the ants.
(Optional) Place Loyal's sonic emitter on the Ant mound.
(Optional) Activate the sonic emitter.
Return to Raquel and let her know the generators are running again.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Ant Misbehavin'
Speak with Raquel at the Nellis Air Force Base.
(Optional) Pass a 50 Speech/Science skill check; to acquire the sonic emitter from Loyal
Reach the Nellis array.
Restart the 2 array generators, then reset the main breaker.
Kill all giant ants directly or; using the sonic emitter on the nest.
(Optional) Pass a 55 Speech skill check to lie about killing the ants to Raquel
Killed the ants: 400 XP, Boomers fame.; Lied to Raquel: 400 XP, Karma loss, Boomers fame.

notes: The giant ants in the array will explode and deal damage to any nearby creatures if killed with certain types of weapons, including: explosives, energy weapons, the ballistic fist, the Ripper, or the chainsaw. Most conventional ballistic weapons appear to be fine, although not in the case of guns from the Honest Hearts add-on. (See the Bugs section.)
It is possible to shoot and explode the howitzer shells inside the array while killing the ants, which will cause multiple explosions if any ants are killed by it.
The catwalk is not high enough to avoid the explosion of howitzer shells if one accidentally occurs.
ED-E's electrical zap melee attack and shots from Arcade Gannon's Plasma Defender ranged weapon also cause the ants to explode.

name: Anywhere I Wander
reward_text: 100 XP; NCR fame

stages.description: Rescue the NCR hostages from the Techatticup Mine.
Report back to Private Renolds.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Anywhere I Wander
Speak with Pvt. Renolds.
Enter Techatticup Mine.
Rescue or kill the NCR troopers.
Return to Private Renolds.
Reward: 100 XP; NCR fame.

notes: As soon as the gates are unlocked, the Legion soldiers will turn hostile if one's reputation with the Legion is lower than Neutral. Consequently, all remaining legionnaires in the mine will attack the fleeing troopers once they are untied.
While it is not required to follow the prisoners escaping the mine, if one or both are killed at any point before returning to Renolds, the quest will fail.
Killing the two troopers in sight of Legion soldiers will not cause them to turn hostile.
The quest may be unobtainable if Renolds is killed by legionary assassins that spawn in the area. There are also fire geckos in the area that could pose a threat to him.
Renolds will have unique dialogue if one entered the mine before talking to him and freed the hostages.

name: Arachnophobia
reward_text: Edwards left alive:; Karma gain; 50 bottle capsEdwards dead:; 60 XP; Karma loss

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: Arachnophobia
Reach Camp Searchlight east of Wolfhorn Ranch and speak with First Sergeant Astor to start the side quest We Will All Go Together.

Locate and enter the Searchlight home in the southwest side of the town; to speak with the ghoulified Private Kyle Edwards;; choose questioning dialogue options to find out about his fear of radscorpions keeping him from leaving.
Agree to wipe out the radscorpion pack for Edwards.
Pass a 60 Speech skill check to lie that the radscorpions are already dead and he can leave.
60 XP; Karma loss
Assist Pvt. Edwards in deciding a new course of action.
Choose dialogue options to convince Edwards to wander the wasteland.
Suggest talking to 1st Sgt. Astor about Edwards rejoining the NCR.

Choose questioning dialogue options to ask Astor about other NCR posts Edwards can join; OR; pass a 50 Speech check / 7 Intelligence attribute check to convince Astor that the non-feral Edwards is safe to join his squad.
Pass a 60 Speech check to lie about Astor accepting Edwards' help and he can leave to join them.
Karma gain; 50 bottle caps
60 XP; Karma loss

name: Arizona Killer
reward_text: Legion fame

stages.description: Rendezvous with Cato Hostilius.
Report to Cato when you are prepared.
Kill President Kimball.

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: Arizona Killer
Talk to Cato Hostilius.
Infilitrate Hoover Dam and meet with the disguised Cato.
Assassinate President Aaron Kimball.
Attack and kill Kimball.
Plant the bomb on the vertibird (50 Explosives required).
Plant a C-4 plastic explosive on Jeremy Watson's helmet and detonate it near Kimball (50 Explosives required).
Rig the howitzer to explode/shoot down the vertibird (50 Science/Repair required).
Sabotage the vertibird. (50 Science required)
Reward: XP; Legion fame; Achievement/Trophy
Leads to: Veni, Vidi, Vici

notes: Drawing a weapon while near the visitor center and after the President has arrived will result in the President and NCR reacting as if he had come under attack, even if one is hidden and has not attacked. However, the NCR will not turn hostile unless they see through the Courier's disguise.

Any method that involves destroying the Vertibird with Kimball aboard, employing explosives or high impact projectiles (e.g. a Gauss rifle) runs the risk of making President Kimball's suit and the Meat of Champions perk unobtainable due to the inaccessible or lost corpse.

During this quest, the Legion sends Cato and the player character to perform the assassination, whereas during You'll Know It When It Happens, the NCR/House/Independent mirror version, the Legion still sends two assassins. Each of the three methods of assassination one must thwart as an ally of the NCR in the latter quest are also available as means of assassination during the former quest: placing a bomb on Bear Force One, sniping Kimball from the tower behind the stage, and attacking him directly from the crowd.

One can complete this quest along with the Gun Runners' Arsenal challenge Sic Semper Tyrannis by using a hunting revolver to snipe Kimball, killing him with the benefit of being at a distance one can then escape easily.

name: Arizona Scavenger
reward_text: Legion fameCaps; OR; Assorted ammunition and items

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: Arizona Scavenger
Reach Cottonwood Cove and speak with Aurelius of Phoenix at or in the HQ building;; agree to collect proof of NCR kills to aid the Legion.

Pickpocket/collect NCR dogtags from NCR troopers and Rangers and return them to Aurelius;; pass a 35 Barter skill check to persuade him to allow Decanus Severus to trade dogtags for ammo and supplies.
Reward: Legion fame; Caps or assorted ammunition and items

notes: The NCR troopers found at some associated locations (such as Camp Golf) are known to respawn every 3-4 game days, allowing one to theoretically collect infinite NCR dogtags, Legion fame, and ammo and supplies (if trading with Severus) through this quest.
NCR dogtags can be pickpocketed from the drunk troopers found wandering around the Strip.

Prior to being patched, one could kill the injured soldiers scattered throughout the no-man's-land between Nelson and Camp Forlorn Hope and retrieve their dogtags to gain Legion fame without a Karma or NCR reputation loss. Beware of frag mines placed near or under their bodies as traps. Injured soldiers will respawn every three in-game days.
Mister Sandman kills can also be performed without a Karma or NCR reputation loss.
When trading with Severus, the most profitable item to gain from him is the 10mm SMG, having a dogtag-to-cap ratio of 1:79.

Due to several bugs with Decanus Severus' dialog, the fastest way to accumulate Legion fame is to turn in tags for food, five at a time. This nets +12 to Legion fame for every 5 tags turned in, with 100 fame granting the highest possible positive reputation.

If one is Vilified with the Legion, but not yet started Render Unto Caesar by receiving the Mark of Caesar, it is still possible to start this quest. Initially, if one asks for supplies in trade for dogtags, they won't be able to get them, as Decanus Severus will not engage in dialogue; in this case, one can still trade in dogtags to Aurelius for caps and Legion fame. One will be required to wear faction armor in order to engage Severus in conversation and access his rewards.

name: Arrival at Zion
reward_text: Variable XP; Follows-Chalk as a companion (optional); Merchant & repair services with Joshua Graham

stages.description: Follow Jed Masterson.
(Optional) Defeat the White Legs assault.
Move into Zion Valley.
Travel to the Dead Horses camp at Eastern Virgin.
Speak with Joshua Graham.

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: Arrival at Zion
Follow the Happy Trails caravan into Zion from the southern passage.
Survive the White Legs ambush and kill the attackers.
Flee from the White Legs ambush.
Reach Angel Cave near the Eastern Virgin independently or with help from Follows-Chalk.
Speak with Joshua Graham.
Reward: Variable XP; Follows-Chalk as a companion (optional); Merchant & repair services with Joshua Graham
Leads to: Gone Fishin', Roadside Attraction, Tourist Trap, Chaos in Zion

notes: When Follows-Chalk appears and kills the White Leg tribal while crossing the bridge, attempting to shoot the ambusher can lead to accidentally shooting Follows-Chalk instead. This will result in him, the Dead Horses, the Sorrows, Daniel, and Joshua Graham all turning hostile, failing the remaining quests and starting Chaos in Zion.
The duffle bags located near the ambush site are safe to store items in until the add-on is completed.
When approaching Angel Cave for the first time, a Dead Horse tribal called "Two-Bears-High-Fiving" will emerge, pump his fist in the air, and then quickly enter the cave again.

rules.when: Follows-Chalk is shot by the player
rules.note: Dead Horses, Sorrows, Daniel and Joshua Graham turn hostile; remaining Honest Hearts quests fail

name: Back in the Saddle
reward_text: 50 caps; 50 XP; Varmint rifle; 140-150 5.56mm rounds; Goodsprings fame (optional); 3 purified water (optional)

stages.description: Talk to Sunny Smiles in the Prospector Saloon.
Meet Sunny Smiles behind the Prospector Saloon.
Shoot 3 sarsaparilla bottles outside the Prospector Saloon.
Follow Sunny.
Kill the geckos at the well.
Talk to Sunny Smiles.
Kill the geckos at the other wells.
Talk to Sunny about your reward.

walkthrough.text: Tutorial Quest: Back in the Saddle
Talk to Sunny Smiles at the Prospector Saloon.
Learn about firearms with Sunny by shooting empty Sunset Sarsaparilla bottles
Agree to Sunny's request for aid in clearing out geckos from the Goodsprings source.
Decline Sunny's request for aid.
Leads to: They Went That-a-Way
Reward: XP; 50 caps; Goodsprings fame
Leads to: By a Campfire on the Trail.

notes: If Cheyenne is killed during the gecko fight, Sunny will appear distraught in the next conversation, then apologize to the Courier for her display of emotion.

During the quest, one can immediately complete it by talking to Sunny at three different points with the option marked [END TUTORIAL], leading to her pointing the player character to Trudy's location to begin They Went That-a-Way:
After shooting the bottles.
After killing the geckos at the first well.
After killing the geckos at the two other wells.
The bottles will not appear until one talks to Sunny in the saloon and follows her to the back of the building.
The bottles that appear on the back fence cannot be picked up or taken.
The bottles can be shot down by the player with any ranged weapon and not just the varmint rifle Sunny gives to them.
A bark scorpion that hangs around Goodsprings Cemetery may randomly wander near the saloon.

If one runs out of ammunition during the bottle shooting segment, they can talk to Sunny and be given a one-time additional amount of 30 5.56mm rounds to use. This can be exploited by simply dropping the 5.56 ammo directly from the inventory before starting to shoot, talking to Sunny to get the additional ammo, and then picking it back up.

There is a small chance of a Powder Ganger walking through the hunting area. The player character can kill him which may cause a second Powder Ganger to attack later. Finally, a third Powder Ganger may attack while on the road leaving Goodsprings.

It is almost impossible to save the settler if one only follows after Sunny. To have the best chance of gaining the town fame and purified water rewards, after killing the geckos at the second well, do not wait for Sunny and immediately run to the third and kill the geckos quickly.

name: Back in Your Own Backyard
reward_text: 150 XP; 50 Caps; NCR fame; Legion infamy

stages.description: Kill the NCR Hostages.
Return to Milo at the NCR Checkpoint.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Back in Your Own Backyard
Speak with Ranger Milo southwest of Nelson.
Free the NCR hostages.
Kill the NCR hostages.
Reward: 150 XP; 50 Caps; NCR fame, Legion infamy.

notes: Legionary assassins may attack and wipe out the NCR checkpoint even while one is raiding Nelson per the quest objective, preventing the player from completing the quest if Milo is killed.

One can attempt to prevent this from occurring by leaving their companions behind in wait mode at the checkpoint to bolster the area's defenses. It can be made even easier by placing the companions in front of the soldiers as human shields, and even more so using Veronica's glitch to have every companion in the game (minus one of the non-humanoids) all at once and equipping them with heavy armor and weapons.

Completing this quest with Boone as an active companion will earn "history" points towards triggering his companion quest I Forgot to Remember to Forget, of which 1 of the required 5 points is gained by killing the hostages, and 2 of 5 by rescuing them.

Should one try to rescue the hostages, it is not required to keep them safe until they reach the checkpoint. They will be considered rescued as long as one of the untied troopers is still alive when the player character initiates dialogue with Milo to complete the quest.
Legion soldiers assigned to Nelson will turn hostile if one hits or unties any of the hostages, even if the act is undetected. The Legion mongrels in the area are unaffected by this.

There are four Legion explorers stationed at each of the four cardinal directions from the camp who will confront the player character if approached. See here for further details of the interaction. If one has a neutral reputation with the Legion and agrees to be escorted to Dead Sea, all four explorers will disappear from the town.

If, for any reason, the Legion is hostile towards the Courier at the moment, the aforementioned explorers will always "sense" the player character when approached for the first time, no matter how "stealthy" the player character is. This only happens once for each explorer, and one with high enough Sneak skill or the help of stealth-enhancing items, such as a Stealth Boy, can still avoid full detection.

Although this quest and Restoring Hope can be done in any order, in the case of the latter completing before the former, the NCR troops walking around the recaptured Nelson will be oblivious to the three crucified troopers near them.

Alternatively, one can help the NCR wipe out the Legion's control of Nelson and complete Restoring Hope without rescuing the hostages, before having ever spoken with Ranger Milo. This may result in Milo mentioning how they helped the NCR to take Nelson from the Legion, and then immediately gives them this quest as if Nelson was still under control of the Legion.

After convincing Ranger Milo to allow the player character to help with the hostage situation, he will make a joke about enhancing the troopers' combat prowess with Psycho. If one has at least 24 samples of Psycho in the inventory, a unique dialogue option is unlocked to give them to him. This will not change the quest but will garner a small amount of NCR fame.

rules.note: Dead Sea becomes permanently hostile

name: Barton the Fink
reward_text: Miscellaneous loot

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: Barton the Fink
Complete By a Campfire on the Trail for Sunny Smiles, then speak to Barton Thorn at the nearby campsite.;; agree to check out the nearby cliffs for his girlfriend.
Go to the gecko nest site past the old radio tower;; eliminate the creatures and investigate the campsite at the incline peak.
Kill Barton after his betrayal.
Reward: Miscellaneous loot

notes: If one takes the Animal Friend perk, killing the geckos is not necessary, as they will not be hostile towards the player character. Thorn will still remark on them clearing out the geckos as if they had done so when speaking with him. The geckos could potentially kill Thorn immediately after he says this.
The player character can ask for 50 caps as payment for helping him. Barton will agree to this, however, he is lying and will never pay up.

The prospector's camp can be reached without exiting the invisible boundary that finalizes character's attributes and skills by maneuvering southward along the clifftops from Victor's shack. This route is useful in reaching the camp while avoiding the geckos guarding the ridge as well.
After killing Barton Thorn, his corpse will disappear from the game after leaving the cell for a while.
Because of the geckos spawning in the area, Thorn can sometimes be found already dead before one can meet him.

name: Beyond the Beef
reward_text: 100-500 XP; 250-500 caps; Strip fame/infamy; White Glove Society fame/infamy

stages.description: Ask around the Ultra-Luxe for information regarding Ted Gunderson's disappearance.
Inquire with Mortimer at the Ultra-Luxe about the investigator.
Get Ted back to his father if he is still alive.

Talk to Carlyle St. Clair at his residence north of the Strip.
(Optional) Lock one of your human companions in the Ultra-Luxe kitchen freezer as replacement for Ted.
Drag Carlyle's body into the dumpster alongside his house.
Return to Mortimer in the Ultra-Luxe

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Beyond the Beef
Reach the Ultra-Luxe casino on the New Vegas Strip.
Speak with Marjorie and Mortimer around the casino.
Resolve the White Glove Society's affairs
Bring Ted Gunderson back to Heck Gunderson alive and prevent the Society's return to cannibalism.
Return Ted Gunderson back to Heck Gunderson alive and ensure the Society's return to cannibalism by capturing Carlyle St. Clair III.
Ensure the Society's return to cannibalism by killing Ted Gunderson and framing Heck Gunderson for his murder.
Eradicate the White Glove Society and rescue Ted Gunderson.
Reward: 100-500 XP; 250-500 caps; Strip fame; White Glove Society fame.

notes: The decision to help the White Glove Society or not does not have any repercussions in the game or even when completing the quest for the Legion during Render Unto Caesar (other than gaining Legion fame and significant Karma loss. This is the only quest in New Vegas that doesn't carry any repercussions between factions, towns, locations or non-player characters. This is also one of the few quests that allows for bypassing the bulk of the quest progression and kill almost everyone in it without damaging meaningful faction reputation or Karma.

If choosing to drug the banquet wine, after the head waiter picks up the drugged wine, you can pickpocket it off him with no change in the current objective (the White Glove Society members will still become comatose).

Also, when entering the dining hall, attempting to talk to the unconscious White Gloves actually opens up their extended inventory (the clothes they are currently wearing will be listed), which can be looted without loss of Karma or reputation. Even after finishing the quest, the members will not replace their clothing or masks, and they will walk around in their underwear. Also, if one tries to wake them up when they are drugged by hitting one and then "holstering" one's fists, they all will walk around the room and can still be looted as if they were unconscious but cannot be interacted with further until one leaves.

If all the Securitrons on the Strip were killed previously, it can be difficult to finish this quest via framing Gunderson as the quest markers will simply point to empty spaces and the Securitrons can take a very long time to respawn. This can be detrimental when playing on Hardcore as you will most likely have to wait for over a week, during which time you will have to keep sleep, dehydration and hunger levels down. On the PC version accessing the console, targeting a dead Securitron and entering the command "resurrect" will restore the robot to life and allow you to complete the quest.
Mr. House will have unique dialogue if one sides with him and then completes this quest by either stopping Mortimer's plans or helping him return the Society to cannibalism.

If one chooses to frame Heck Gunderson for his son's death, the Securitron that comes to arrest him will be a Mark I, regardless of whether one upgraded the Securitron army at the Fort to Mark II for either Mr. House or Yes Man.
If you bring Ted back to Heck and then kill Heck, the White Glove Society will shun you, but Heck's hired gun will help you fight them.

Picking the lock to the door that leads to the cashier's booth will result in negative Karma, and upon approaching the cashier, he will become hostile. However, if you simply pick the lock then shut the door, there will be no resulting hostility.

Following a patch, the only way to receive Strip fame from this quest is to dissuade Heck Gunderson from imposing a food blockade, which is possible only if Ted was brought back alive to his father, thus failing Pheeble Will. Helping Mortimer gains Idolized reputation with the White Glove Soceity but has no effect on one's Strip reputation. (It's also possible to just kill Ted and lie to Heck that he was found but don't know who did it, which will also grant Strip fame as well as White Glove fame).

As of version 1.4, neither Mortimer nor Marjorie's dialogue options about cannibalism or Ted Gunderson will appear until an offer is made to Heck to find his son, making talking to Heck the only way to start the quest.

The option to offer up a human companion to Mortimer as a substitution serves as the only way outside of Hardcore mode for them to be permanently killed without changing one's reputation with any other factions that might result in them turning hostile and becoming non-essential.

rules.when: dissuade Heck from a food blockade
rules.note: Needs Ted alive, which fails Pheeble Will; killing Ted and lying to Heck also gives Strip fame
Walter and Ethel disappear from the Strip

name: Big Winner
reward_text: Bon Vivant suite; The Tops High Roller suite; Caps; Complimentary voucher ; Various other loot; Permanent ban from gambling in listed casinos

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: Big Winner
Win the maximum 2,500 chips while gambling at the Vikki and Vance Casino in Primm.
Win the maximum 5,000 chips while gambling at the Atomic Wrangler Casino in Freeside.
Win the maximum 9,000 chips while gambling at Gomorrah on the Strip.
Win the maximum 10,000 chips while gambling at the Tops on the Strip.
Win the maximum 15,000 chips while gambling at the Ultra-Luxe on the Strip.
Win the maximum 10,000 chips while gambling at the Sierra Madre casino.

Reward: Bon Vivant suite as player character housing; The Tops High Roller suite as player character housing; Caps; Complimentary voucher ; Various other loot; Permanent ban from gambling in listed casinos

notes: Unlike the other casinos, there is no floor manager in the Atomic Wrangler Casino or Ultra-Luxe. For the former, when the player character reaches a chips threshold while gambling, a Jackpot sound will be heard and they automatically receive the prize(s), while the latter has a generic White Glove comes to the player character to reward them.

The Sierra Madre's casino uses holograms as table managers; since the holograms do not talk to the player character, the award is automatically given once choosing the relevant "dialogue" option, and one will instead get a notification about the prize winnings and the eventual permanent ban.
Winning the maximum and receiving the permanent ban at all three casinos on the Strip during their associated quests will unlock the "The Courier Who Broke the Bank" achievement/trophy.

If one wants to win the renewable supply of complimentary vouchers from the Sierra Madre casino, it is advisable to begin gambling as soon as the casino is available during Put the Beast Down, since as soon as one leaves the Sierra Madre to return to the Mojave Wasteland after finishing the Dead Money add-on, it is normally impossible to return again.

name: Big Winner, Atomic Wrangler
reward_text: Caps; Banned from gambling in the casino
notes: The Atomic Wrangler Casino doesn't have a table manager like the other casinos. When the money target is reached, a jackpot sound will be heard and the player character automatically wins the prize they should receive.

name: Big Winner, Sierra Madre
reward_text: Consumables; Clothing; Complimentary voucher; Banned from gambling in it
notes: If the player breaks the house limit before getting any comp gifts (by getting a large win), they will not receive any comps they have missed.

Unlike other casinos, the Sierra Madre will exchange chips for pre-War money at a 1:1 ratio. This is a useful way to generate a large amount of weightless goods for sale after returning to the Mojave.

Receiving a complimentary voucher (worth 1000 chips) unlocks the means to redeem the vouchers at vending machines. This MUST be done if the Courier wants to be able to redeem the vouchers they will regularly receive at the abandoned BoS bunker upon completion of Dead Money.

name: Big Winner, The Gomorrah
reward_text: Caps; Banned from gambling in the casino

name: Big Winner, The Tops
reward_text: Key to The High Roller suite; Caps; Banned from gambling in the casino.
notes: If the player character breaks the house limit before getting any comp gifts (by getting a large win) they will not receive any comps they have missed.

The quest is shown as completed when the Courier enters The Tops High Roller suite, so being banned from the casino is optional; however, being banned is required if one wants the "The Courier Who Broke the Bank" achievement/trophy.

name: Big Winner, Ultra-Luxe
reward_text: Caps; Bon Vivant suite key; Brahmin Wellington; Atomic cocktail; Banned from gambling in the casino
notes: The Ultra-Luxe doesn't have a table manager. Instead, a normal White Glove dispenses the rewards. His pathing to the player is often a bit awkward.

name: Big Winner, Vikki & Vance
reward_text: Caps; Banned from gambling in the casino

name: Bighorners of the Eastern Virgin
reward_text: Variable XP; .45 Auto pistol; 10 .45 Auto, hollow point rounds; War club

stages.description: Find a way up to the Cliffs.
Find the lost Mountain Bighorner Calf.

Kill all of the Mountain Bighorners.
Speak with Follows-Chalk.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Bighorners of the Eastern Virgin

Feed the lost calf banana yucca fruit to lead it back to its mother.
Speak with Follows-Chalk.
Reward: Variable XP; .45 Auto pistol; 10 .45 Auto, hollow point rounds; War club

notes: The bighorner calf can fall off the rocks; while immune to damage, this still makes its pathfinding route difficult to reconcile.
It is possible for a bighorner to stray into the Dead Horses camp, where the NPCs may kill it if it becomes aggressive and cause the optional objective to fail.
Similarly, a giant cazador may appear and attack the bighorners.
Occasionally, a Dead Horses tribe member may also wander up the path leading to the bighorners herd and attack if they become aggressive.
If the bighorner mountain mother is killed before starting the quest, it can still be successfully completed by returning the calf and then talking to Follows-Chalk.
Occasionally, a bighorner may wander into a narrow pathway, causing issues especially when trying to go around it.

name: Birds of a Feather
reward_text: 600 XP; 1450-1850 caps; Van Graff combat armor

stages.description: Go outside and talk to Simon.
Take up position on the other side of the Silver Rush entrance.
Guard the Silver Rush entrance.
Report back to Gloria.
Deliver the package to a man at the designated location.
Report back to Gloria that the package has been delivered.
Talk to Jean-Baptiste to receive your next assignment.
Find Rose of Sharon Cassidy and get her to follow you.
(Optional) Visit Alice McLafferty, who might know where Rose of Sharon Cassidy is currently located.
Bring the Cassidy girl to Jean-Baptiste.
Return to the Silver Rush in Freeside and Tell Jean-Baptiste that the Cassidy girl is dead.
Report to Gloria Van Graff for your next assignment.
Kill the remaining Legion troops.
Report to Gloria Van Graff that all of the Legion troops are dead.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Birds of a Feather
Speak with Gloria Van Graff in the Silver Rush.
Work with Simon as a Van Graff guard.
Let each visitor in unchecked or; Demand they submit to a search (65 Speech required) or; Refuse them entry.
All five visitors checked before entry/refused entry.
Allow the fourth visitor in unchecked.
Quest failure
Speak with Gloria.
Deliver the package to the strange man.
Return to Gloria.
Speak with Jean-Baptiste Cutting.
Locate Rose of Sharon Cassidy and bring her to the Silver Rush.
Cass already dead: Inform Jean-Baptiste of Cassidy's death.
Speak with Gloria.
Go to the abandoned warehouse and oversee the Legion weapon deal.
Speak with Gloria again.
Reward: 600 XP; Van Graff combat armor; 1000 caps; NCR fame; Freeside fame

notes: Normally, one is forced to either let Cass die or fight the Van Graffs as soon as one initiates dialogue with Jean-Baptiste. However, with the perk Terrifying Presence, one can exit the dialogue and take more time before coming to a final decision on how to handle the situation. This option works countless times, but the quest will not continue until a permanent solution is chosen.

As of patch 1.2.0.31x, completing Heartache by the Number peacefully will turn the Van Graffs permanently hostile. Apparently, word gets around that the player character turned them in to the NCR. This makes it impossible to complete both Birds of a Feather and Heartache by the Number in the same playthrough.
After the quest is completed, Gloria will claim that someone else will replace the Courier as a second door guard for the Silver Rush. This never happens in-game.
When Simon announces that a customer is approaching, one can simply wait for one hour and the walking NPC will appear in front instantly rather than waiting for them to walk over in real time.

The Official Game Guide erroneously states that a Speech 60 skill check is required to convince the third visitor that arrives while guarding the door to submit to a search, when it is actually a Speech 65 skill check.
If one pickpockets the bomb from the man who wants to blow up the Silver Rush and then lets him in, the store will still explode.
While Simon will assist the player character in killing the suicide bomber, he will not assist them in killing Pacer if he is turned hostile.

If the suicide bomber and/or Pacer is killed by Simon or the player character, their bodies will be placed in the dumpster to the right of the Silver Rush's door, provided it has not been disintegrated or melted.

Pacer will have unique dialogue during this quest if G.I. Blues was previously completed by helping eliminate the NCR missionaries instead of brokering peace with the Kings, in which he will be more cordial instead of condescending.The Courier: "Good to see you too, Pacer."; Pacer: "I'm sure it's the highlight of your day. Anyway, I gotta bounce. Things to do, and all that."; (Pacer's dialogue)
Upon completing the first part of the quest acting as a door guard, the player character will be able to come and go from the Silver Rush without having their weapons confiscated by Simon.

The player character can start this quest by bringing Cass to the Silver Rush and talking to Jean-Baptiste Cutting. The quest will begin and, after a short dialogue, he will attack Cass. However, since the player character has never gone through the earlier stages of the quest, Simon will still take all the player character's weapons on entry, and will continue to do so even if one goes out and back in after Cass is dead. This makes it harder to complete the final stage, because after talking to Gloria Van Graff to start the final section, one automatically fast-travels to the abandoned warehouse, still with no weapons except for concealed ones.

If Cass was previously recruited as a companion but has since left because the player character had evil Karma, the only way to complete the "kill Cass" section of the quest is to try to catch her before she leaves the map and kill her. Her path back to the west passes through the locked gate at the Mojave Outpost.

Once Gloria has been spoken to, the final part of the quest begins immediately and one will not be able to retrieve any items from Cass's body. They can still be recovered from her ashes at the end of the quest.

On PC, it is possible to complete this quest and still keep Cass as a companion using console commands. When Jean-Baptiste is killing Cass, her body will turn into a pile of ash. While her corpse is still disintegrating, go into the console, select her, and type . The quest will then proceed normally. If this does not work, use a Stealth Boy and disarm Jean-Baptiste by shooting his weapon with a silenced weapon, talk to him with Cass present, type , kill Cass then quickly talk to him, then before the death notification of Cass appears, type then click on her body.

On PC, it is also possible to skip the stage of bringing Cass to Jean-Baptiste using console commands. Talk with Jean-Baptiste and tell him you'll go find her. Afterwards, enter the following the commands into the console: , , and .

If Craig Boone is in the player's company when transported to the Abandoned warehouse to deal with the Legion, he is not automatically hostile to them, nor are they hostile to him, and hostility only occurs when the NCR soldiers' gas grenade is thrown into the Legion troops.

If one has failed Don't Tread on the Bear!, all of the NCR troopers who ambush the legionaries during the exchange will be hostile. Killing them, however, has no impact on the quest and one is free to do so without affecting anything but one's NCR reputation.
The prime legionaries encountered in the warehouse are equipped with Legion veteran armor instead of Legion prime armor.
If you attack the Van Graffs instead of the legionaries, they will turn neutral, and Van Graffs hostile.

Originally, the execution scene that serves as the intro to the quest was longer. The intro originally had Gloria reveal that the man they are executing is a former lover of hers. She caught him cheating on her at a casino and she is now using him as an example for Mr. Soren to show even if she loves him, she will kill him, as a show to never break faith with her organization.

Speak with Boxcars in the Nipton General Store.
Reach the Legion raid camp to free the captives.

notes: Killing Boxcars during the quest will cause it to fail, even if he is killed after telling the player character about the Legion's slaves and no longer being relevant to the quest.
Completing this quest with Boone as an active companion will earn 1 of 5 required "history" points towards triggering his companion quest, I Forgot to Remember to Forget.

Like with other Legion-controlled locations, Boone will automatically attack the legionnaires once he's in range, earning Legion infamy. He will not attack, however, if the player character is wearing Legion faction armor at the time.

If one rescues the prisoners before even talking to Boxcars and/or starting this quest, they can still talk to Boxcars and start the quest later, causing it to automatically complete, and still earn the "history" points towards Boone's quest if he is present.

Once rescued, the two Powder Gangers will run south to the old nuclear test site, where they will most likely be killed by the feral ghouls in the area. Even if they are killed beforehand and the area cleared, the Powder Gangers will simply stand around the area in front of Trash's shack until the ghouls respawn.
Boxcars will not offer any new dialogue options related to the captives' freedom after completing the quest.

If one waits too long near the Legion raid camp during this quest, they may find it overrun by a night stalker attack, with all the Legion members dead and both of the prisoners gone. In this case, it seems impossible to finish the quest.

If one also waits too long and fast travels to the Legion raid camp during this quest, they may find it being attacked by the night stalkers, which can attack both the Legion members and the prisoners. If the prisoners are killed by the night stalkers, the quest will fail.
