walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: Bounty Killer
Reach Camp McCarran and speak with Colonel James Hsu;; ask about the camp's problems with the Fiends.
Agree to help the NCR by assassinating Motor-Runner in Vault 3.
Reach Vault 3 in the South Vegas ruins south-southwest of Camp McCarran.
(Optional) Locate and speak with the injured Ranger Bryce Anders in the living quarters.
Offer to use a doctor's bag to heal him.
Attack and kill him or; pass a 75 Speech skill check to convince him to attack Motor-Runner immediately.
Karma loss
Pass a 75 Speech check to recruit him as a temporary companion or; choose dialogue options to convince him to return to McCarran.
Enter the maintenance section, kill Motor-Runner and obtain Motor-Runner's helmet.
Return to Col. Hsu.
Reward: NCR fame (increased if Anders left alive); 300 caps

notes: Bryce Anders will die if he takes any non-zero amount of damage, regardless of what conversation options have been used to get him moving; this is due to him being scripted that if he is hurt by a member of the Fiends he dies instantly. This was done to ensure his death if chosen to send him in alone, but the effect remains active indefinitely even after he leaves the Vault if convinced. To keep him alive, it is best to either send him back to base or clean out the whole vault prior to enlisting his aid with Motor-Runner.

He can also be killed by Fiends in the entrance area of the vault after meeting him and tell him to wait. It appears that although there is a wall between the room where Bryce stays and the entrance area, the Fiends can actually shoot 'through' the wall. Thus it is important to clear the Fiends as quickly as possible if one wants him to survive.

If one has not yet started Aba Daba Honeymoon (and wants to at some point) it is recommended to refrain from entering the maintenance wing with Motor-Runner due to a bug with Motor-Runner that causes him to initiate his dialogue options only once. Thus it is advisable to trigger Aba Daba Honeymoon with Diane first and advance it to the point of delivering the package to Motor-Runner, otherwise that quest may fail.

Conversely, upon killing Motor-Runner, if Aba Daba Honeymoon was not completed beforehand, it will immediately be marked as failed. This can be solved by completing the parts of that quest that require Motor-Runner alive before accepting this quest. Once that is done, he is fair game. Alternatively, faking Motor-Runner's death by merely acquiring his helmet from pickpocketing will avoid the need to kill him.

If one kills Motor-Runner before starting this quest, Anders may appear at the vault entrance (in the Wasteland) and will begin walking back to Camp McCarran. This may also occur if one takes Motor-Runner's helmet to claim the bounty and leaves him alive.
Colonel Hsu may give thanks for saving Anders even if the player hasn't met him.

If one has previously entered Vault 3 wearing Great Khan armor during Aba Daba Honeymoon, the Fiends will not be hostile the next time one enters even if they are not wearing the outfit. Upon killing Motor-Runner, only the Fiends in the adjacent area will become hostile, not the entire Vault.

rules.when: Motor-Runner killed before Aba Daba Honeymoon is completed

name: Brotherhood Bond
reward_text: Brotherhood of Steel fame

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: Brotherhood Bond
Complete relevant quests and special actions up to earning a Liked reputation with the Brotherhood of Steel.
Re-enter the Hidden Valley bunker and meet the initiate in the front chamber.
Reward: Brotherhood of Steel fame

name: By a Campfire on the Trail
source: By a Campfire on the Trail
reward_text: Healing powder

stages.description: Find a broc flower and a xander root
Use the campfire to make healing powder
Go and meet Trudy at the Prospector Saloon.

walkthrough.text: Tutorial Quest: By a Campfire on the Trail
Locate at least one broc flower and xander root.
Collect the marked xander root by the tree trunk outside of the Goodsprings schoolhouse.
Collect the marked broc flower at the Goodsprings Cemetery
Bring the ingredients to Sunny Smiles and use a campfire to craft healing powder.
Reward: XP
Next Quest: They Went That-a-Way

notes: If one acquires the marked plants, then sells or consumes all the broc flowers and xander root in their inventory before giving them to Sunny Smiles, the waypoint will disappear, but the ingredients will respawn every 72 hours.
If healing powder is already in the inventory, Sunny will move on with the quest as if they had created it using the campfire.
Some unmarked broc flowers and at least one xander root can be found on the cliff where Barton Thorn sends the player character as part of Barton the Fink.

name: Bye Bye Love
reward_text: 1000 caps; 200 XP

stages.description: Find Carlitos to help Joana escape Gomorrah.
Talk to Joana, on Carlitos' behalf, at Gomorrah.
Joana has decided to escape Gomorrah. Talk to Carlitos about her decision.
Carlitos wants to meet Joana in Freeside, between midnight and dawn. Explain the plan to Joana.
(Optional) Carlitos suggests getting backup before attempting the escape. Find the two guns-for-hire that owe him a favor.
Joana agreed to Carlitos' plan. Talk to her once you're ready to escort her during the escape.
Joana will wait, in disguise, at Gomorrah's lobby. go there and lead the girls to Freeside.
Help Joana, and the girls, in their escape to Freeside.
The help of two experted shooters is secured - granting extra protection during the escape.
I decided to tell Cachino about Joana's intentions to escape. He wants me to turn the hired guns of Carlitos at the meeting.
Joana is safely delivered to Carlitos. The Omertas who set up the ambush are gone.
Joana is free and reunited with Carlitos. She spoke about rumors of a sinister Omertas' operation.
Joana died. You can no longer help Carlitos to get her back.
Carlitos died and will never be reunited with Joana.
Joana was left on her own as she tried to escape Gomorrah.
Joana is dead. You can no longer help her.
Carlitos is dead. You can no longer help him.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Bye Bye Love
Pass a 40 Medicine skill check with Joana in the Gomorrah courtyard or; a 75 Speech check with Carlitos in the Vault 21 mess hall.
Speak with Joana and Carlitos separately to form a plan to escape the Omertas.
(Optional) Recruit Big Beard and Little Beard in the Atomic Wrangler Casino.
Speak with Joana after 12 a.m. in her room.
Escort Joana and her friends from Gomorrah to Carlitos in Freeside.
Protect Carlitos and Joana during the Omertas' ambush.
Pass two 8 & 9 Strength attribute checks or; two 75 & 85 Speech skill checks or; one 75/85 Barter check to persuade the Omerta thugs to back down.
Talk to Carlitos & Joana.
Reward: 1000 caps; 200 XP
Leads to: How Little We Know

notes: Completing How Little We Know through any path will instantly fail this quest if it is active. Carlitos and Joana will disappear, making it also impossible to start this quest afterwards.
Despite the sense of urgency upon reaching Freeside with the girls, following them to Carlitos isn't necessary.

After dealing with the ambush and saying goodbye to Carlitos and Joana, the group will all exit Freeside via the Freeside gate near King's School of Impersonation. Once they have used the gate, all of the group appear to disappear, including the disguised girls and Big and Little Beard (if the Beards have been hired).

Carlitos, Joana and the rest of the group disappear from the game after finishing the quest if they stay alive, despite the fact that Carlitos and Joana have dialogue proposing that the Courier can meet them afterward. If one quickly talks to Joana or Carlitos after dealing with the Gomorrah thugs, or if they re-enable Joana, she will say "I am happy to see you again. Carlitos and I have been living here since our escape." This may suggest that Carlitos and Joana were originally intended to eventually find a new home after escaping.
Killing any Omerta thugs might cause this quest to become unable to complete, since Joana might turn hostile (it is possible to take out all the guards and still continue this quest).
The wait function cannot be used in the Gomorrah's main lobby while waiting on Joana to approach the two disguised hookers.
If one attempts to wait while Joana is waiting with the other girls, the quest will fail.
Even if they have been escorted to Carlitos, waiting will still make this quest fail.

If one decides to attack the Omerta thugs before they engage in conversation in Freeside, all Omertas in Gomorrah will turn hostile upon returning. This can be avoided by letting the thugs converse before attacking.

rules.when: How Little We Know completed by any path
rules.note: Carlitos and Joana disappear

name: Caching in at the Cove
reward_text: Legion fame; Various loot

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: Caching in at the Cove
Complete relevant quests and special actions up to earning a Mixed or Smiling Troublemaker reputation with Caesar's Legion.
Speak with any unnamed generic Legion NPC; after 73 in-game hours since last interacting with the Legion supply caches during Caesar's Favor/Caesar's Hire.
Reward: Various loot

name: Caesar's Favor
reward_text: ~235 Legion denarius; Random loot

stages.description: Find the Legion Dropbox.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Caesar's Favor
Speak with the disguised frumentarius.
Locate the hidden Legion cache west of Cottonwood Cove.
Collect loot from the cache.
Reward: ~235 Legion denarius; Random loot

notes: As indicated by the disguised frumentarius when he interacts with the player character, any items left inside the cache boxes will be removed once the quest re-appears. However, items taken from the boxes and left on the ground nearby will remain indefinitely.

Additional "Legion Supply Cache" boxes will appear if the player's reputation with Caesar's Legion improves between each instance of this quest. Boxes will not disappear unless the player's reputation is not sufficient for another instance of the quest.

name: Caesar's Foe
reward_text: Legion infamy

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: Caesar's Foe
Complete relevant quests and special actions up to achieving a negative reputation with Caesar's Legion.
Survive the ambush by legionary assassins.
Reward: Legion infamy; Legionary assassins appear in the world

name: Caesar's Hire
reward_text: ~235 Legion denarius; Random loot

stages.description: Find the Legion Dropbox.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Caesar's Hire
Speak with the disguised frumentarius.
Locate the hidden Legion cache west of Cottonwood Cove.
Collect loot from the cache.
Reward: ~235 Legion denarius; Random loot

notes: One can continue accessing the caches even when killing legionnaires if done with undetected stealth kills.

As indicated by the disguised frumentarius when he interacts with the player character, any items left inside the cache boxes will be removed once the quest re-appears. However, items taken from the boxes and left on the ground nearby will remain indefinitely.

Additional "Legion Supply Cache" boxes will appear if the player's reputation with Caesar's Legion improves between each instance of this quest. Boxes will not disappear unless the player's reputation is not sufficient for another instance of the quest.

name: Cajoling a Cudgel
reward_text: The Humble Cudgel

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: Cajoling a Cudgel
Reach the central sewers close to Camp McCarran and obtain Luke's Find from the body of "Sweet" Jill or "Blind" Luke.
Bring Luke's Find to the door to the sealed sewers and loot the dead prospector.
Reward: The Humble Cudgel

name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
source: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
reward_text: 200 XP; NCR fame; Service rifle; 72 armor piercing 5.56mm rounds; 2 caravan lunches; 100 caps; 2 Weapon repair kits

stages.description: Clear out the critters on the road to Ivanpah Lake.
Return to Ranger Jackson at Mojave Outpost.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
Speak with Ranger Jackson at the Mojave Outpost.
Find and kill the giant ants; on the road east of the Nipton Road reststop.
Return to Ranger Jackson.
Reward: 200 XP; NCR fame; Service rifle, 72 armor piercing 5.56mm rounds; 2 caravan lunches; 100 caps; 2 weapon repair kits

name: Chaos in Zion
reward_text: Variable loot

stages.description: Recover the map of Zion Canyon.
Leave Zion and return to the Mojave Wasteland.

walkthrough.text: Honest Hearts main quest: Chaos in Zion
Become hostile with or attack any named character in Zion Canyon, i.e. Joshua Graham, Daniel, Follows-Chalk, or Waking Cloud.
Reach the Narrows and obtain the Zion Canyon map from White Bird's cave.
Leave Zion for the Mojave via the southern passage.
Reward: Variable XP; Variable loot

notes: Completing this quest is the only known way that will allow for White Legs NPCs to continue spawning in Zion.
Generic members of the Sorrows and Dead Horses may remain hostile and attack on sight if left alive.

name: Civilized Man's Burden
reward_text: Variable XP

stages.description: Talk to Joshua Graham about Follows-Chalk's desire to see civilization.
Tell Follows-Chalk your opinion of civilization.

walkthrough.text: Honest Hearts side quest: Civilized Man's Burden
Complete Tourist Trap, then speak with Follows-Chalk, as a companion or at the Dead Horses camp;; ask about his interest in "civilization."
Speak with Joshua Graham about deciding Follows-Chalk's future.
Encourage Follows-Chalk to explore civilization; or; lie to him that Joshua gave his blessing.
Tell Follows-Chalk he must stay with his tribe; or; lie to him that Joshua wants him to stay.
Reward: Variable XP

name: Classic Inspiration
reward_text: 500 caps (additional 150 caps per photo); 950 XP; Strip fame

stages.description: Michael Angelo wants pictures of famous signs around New Vegas.
Take a picture of Novac's Dinosaur Thermometer.
Take a picture of the Bison Steve sign.
Take a picture of the McCarran Airfield sign.
Take a picture of the HELIOS One sign.
Take a picture of the Sunset Sarsaparilla Headquarter's Bottle sign.
Return to Michael Angelo for your reward.
Michael Angelo died. You won't be able to help him any longer.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Classic Inspiration
Speak with Michael Angelo in his workshop on the Strip.

Use the Codac R9000 to take pictures of:; the Dinky the T-Rex statue in Novac,; the McCarran Airfield sign,; the HELIOS One logo,; the Bison Steve Hotel's sign in Primm and; the Sunset Sarsaparilla headquarters' bottle statue.
Return to Michael Angelo on the Strip.
Reward: 500 caps (additional 150 caps per photo); 950 XP; Strip fame

notes: Michael can still be asked for more camera film even after completing the quest despite it and the Codac R9000 no longer having any use.

In the case of the Sunset Sarsaparilla bottle statue at the headquarters, it is only required to get close enough for the label on the bottle to appear (go between the street lamp and New Vegas wall past the old Poesidon gas station from McCarran). One does not have to walk all the way to the building or across the highway. It is a bit harder to accomplish trying to do the same for the McCarran sign, as it is a much smaller target.
If Sarah Weintraub is killed at any point before or during Classic Inspiration, the quest will be failed. Michael will not continue the conversation after she has died.
After triggering Don't Tread on the Bear! during the main story, it is very likely to run into an NCR military police that will attack when returning to receive the reward.
If one successfully extorted Michael during the first meeting, completing the quest may no longer be possible.

rules.note: Also may be impossible if Michael was extorted

name: Claws Mended
reward_text: NCR fame

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: Claws Mended
Reach Sloan east-northeast of Goodsprings and "speak" with the friendly mole rat, Snuffles.
Pass a 30 Medicine skill check to apply first aid to Snuffles' injured leg.
Inform Chomps Lewis about helping Snuffles.
Reward: NCR fame

notes: If one observes Snuffles in V.A.T.S. before passing the Medicine check, one pair of the mole rat's legs is shown to be crippled.
A note exists in the game files that would have pointed the player character to learning about Snuffles' injury, but it was ultimately cut from the game.

name: Claws Out
reward_text: NCR fame; $500

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: Claws Out
Reach Sloan east-northeast of Goodsprings and speak with Chomps Lewis;; ask about the deathclaw presence.
Agree to deal with the infestation at Quarry Junction;; (Level ≥15) Receive a gift of 5 stimpaks and super stimpaks.
Reach Quarry Junction slightly to the northwest and eliminate the deathclaws,; specifically the deathclaw mother and deathclaw alpha male.
Return to Lewis.
Reward: NCR fame; $500

notes: It is not required to talk to Lewis to complete the quest, though when speaking to him after killing the deathclaws, one won't receive the stimpaks.

If the deathclaw mother and/or deathclaw alpha male are killed in a way that does not give the player character XP (e.g. killing them with dynamite dropped on the ground to support a powder charge), the kill will still count towards the quest.
If Chomps Lewis is dead, the player character will not be able to finish the quest for NCR fame.

Finishing this quest will not make quarry workers appear in Quarry Junction, rather workers will show up in Boulder City and will patronize the Big Horn Saloon. Additionally, the bartender Ike will mention that "some badass" wiped out the deathclaws.

name: Climb Ev'ry Mountain
reward_text: 100 XP; NCR fame

stages.description: Find the source of the attacks on Bitter Springs.
Tell Captain Gilles about Oscar Velasco.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Climb Ev'ry Mountain
Speak with Captain Gilles in the NCR camp at Bitter Springs.
Reach the northwestern-most Great Khan supply cave from Bitter Springs.
Deal with Oscar Velasco.
Kill Oscar.
Speak with Oscar to learn about his past.
Pass a 50 Speech skill check to convince Oscar to seek revenge and attack Camp McCarran.
Pass a 50 Speech skill check to convince Oscar to forgo revenge and return to Red Rock Canyon.
Reward: Karma loss
Reward: Karma gain; Great Khans supply cache key.
Return to Captain Gilles at Bitter Springs.
Reward: 100 XP; NCR fame

notes: The small plateau outside of Oscar's cave serves as a good view of the northern end of the map and New Vegas.

If one is wearing NCR attire, Brotherhood of Steel attire or has Boone as an active companion, Oscar will be immediately hostile and attack upon entering the cave. It is advisable to wear non-faction gear and have Boone wait outside the cave, likely all the way back at Bitter Springs if one intends to complete the peaceful route as Oscar will attack him upon leaving the cave.

rules.when: NCR attire, Brotherhood attire or Boone as companion

name: Cold, Cold Heart
reward_text: 150 XP; Legion fame (optional)

stages.description: Spread word of Legion atrocities.
Told the NCR about Vulpes' attack at Nipton.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Cold, Cold Heart
Speak with Vulpes Inculta; outside the Nipton Town Hall.
Tell Sgt. Kilborn; at the Mojave Outpost about Nipton.
Reward: 150 XP; Legion fame (optional).

notes: Completing The Finger of Suspicion for Vulpes first will make this quest unobtainable, as he will no longer appear in Nipton.

The quest also becomes unobtainable if Vulpes is killed prior to first meeting him in Nipton, i.e. avoiding Nipton and meeting him outside the Tops after completing Ring-a-Ding-Ding! When meeting his replacement, Gabban instead, he will not give the quest.
If Boone is an active companion, he will attack the legionaries on sight, preventing conversation with Vulpes.

Selecting the attack option near the end may turn the rest of the Mojave Outpost hostile if Kilborn is not far enough away; waiting until he is near or past the Ranger statues should be safe to kill him even outside of stealth.
If the player character chooses to attack Kilborn while wearing NCR faction armor, he won't turn hostile and the quest will complete normally.

rules.when: The Finger of Suspicion completed first, or Vulpes killed before meeting
rules.note: Vulpes' replacement does not give it

name: Come Fly With Me
reward_text: 800 XP + 200 XP; Novac fame

stages.description: Head to the REPCONN facility west of Novac to investigate rumors of ghoul activity there.
Enter the facility and discover the source of the ghouls.
Head upstairs to meet with the owner of the voice from the intercom.
Speak with Jason Bright, the leader of the REPCONN ghouls.
Head to the REPCONN basement and talk to Jason Bright about what comes next.
Speak to Chris Haversam about firing the rockets.
Find atomic fuel for the rockets.
Return to the Rocket Facility and give the fuel to Chris Haversam.
Find parts to fix the rockets' thrust controllers.
Return to the Rocket Facility and give the parts to Chris Haversam.
Get rid of the Nightkin in the basement.
(Optional) Search the nearby room for the Stealth Boy shipment the Nightkin are looking for.
Report to Jason Bright that the nightkin are gone.
(Optional) Find Harland's friend, who has been imprisoned by the nightkin.
(Optional) Return to Harland and let him know the bad news.
(Optional) Find the leader of the "demons" and speak with him.
(Optional) Return to Davison with news that the Stealth Boys are not in the REPCONN facility.
Talk to Chris Haversam to begin preparations for the rocket launch.
Bring 3 Sugar Bombs to Chris Haversam
(Optional) Sabotage the rockets so that they crash on launch.
Head up to the viewing platform and complete the launch sequence.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Come Fly With Me
Speak with Manny Vargas or No-bark Noonan in Novac.
Reach the REPCONN test site.
Speak with Jason Bright in the upper floors.
Deal with the nightkin inhabiting the basement.
(Optional) Locate the body of Harland's imprisoned friend.
(Optional) Retrieve the Stealth Boy invoice for Davison.
Return to Jason Bright.
Talk to Chris Haversam in the basement.
Purchase the thrust control modules from Old Lady Gibson for 500 caps; (50 Speech/Barter skill check for a 50% discount or Lady Killer for free)
Retrieve the isotope-239 igniting agent from Clark Field or; purchase/steal 5 rocket souvenirs from the Dino Bite gift shop.
Return to Chris.
(Optional) Pass a 50 Speech skill check or use Black Widow to convince Chris to sabotage the rocket launch.
Reward: Karma loss
Go to the observation deck.
(Optional) Pass a 55 Science skill check to improve the launch trajectory from the observation console.
Reward: Karma gain
Launch the REPCONN rockets.
Reward: 1,000 XP; Novac fame

notes: If feral ghouls enter the science lab and attack the player character, it will cause the followers to try to escape and Jason Bright to become hostile.
This can be fixed by reloading the autosave created upon entering the science lab, when the ghouls have not entered yet.

Upon initiating the launch sequence, a radio station called "Launch Music" comes on; this station plays only the "Ride of the Valkyries" by Richard Wagner and shuts off once the Courier leaves the observation deck.
Attempting to move Antler or responding with mocking comments will cause Davison to immediately become hostile to the player character.
Harland cannot be told the bad news about his friend until the part of the quest where they are supposed to enter the basement.

Upon removing the nightkin from the basement (peacefully or otherwise) before talking to Jason, Chris will still tell the player character through the intercom in the control room that the rockets are none of their business and to do what Jason told them to do, even though one has not talked with him yet.

As the rockets take off from the launch pad, one will notice that the main boosters on one rocket seem to have been delayed, resulting in it almost crashing into the building one is standing in before blasting off in a slightly different direction than the others.
Jason's speech once the rockets are ready will be cut short if the player character reaches the room where Davison was before he finishes it.
Additionally, Jason will refer to the Courier during the speech as a male, regardless of gender.(Jason Bright's dialogue)

One only gains 200 XP more if they solve the quest with a non-violent solution (speaking with Davison) and if they help Harland find his friend. Helping Davison but killing Harland grants only 100 XP more.
The space suit and helmet can be found on a shelf in the REPCONN basement overlooking the irradiated rocket hangar, where one goes to give the fuel and thrusters to the ghouls for the rocket.
Attempting to go up the stairs in the room where Harland is located will turn him hostile. One must not only agree to help, but must have found his companion as well to avoid hostilities.
It is not possible to fast travel from the balcony where the launch console sits, post-patch.
It is possible to fast travel after leaving the room and then re-entering (after the launch).
One cannot shoot the launch pad because of a barely visible glass window that cannot be pierced.

If Chris Haversam is not at the REPCONN test site when the player character first goes down, try going back to where Jason Bright's ghouls were located to get Jason Bright to go into the REPCONN test site.

After the rockets are launched, the items in the research lab will still result in negative Karma if one takes them despite the fact that the ghouls will not be using them anymore. This happens even if Chris leaves the facility.
Any feral ghouls that are not killed inside REPCONN will join the "Great Journey." Feral ghouls that are not killed outside REPCONN will still be there and be hostile.
If ED-E is a current companion and is set to "aggressive," ED-E might slaughter all the nightkin in the basement without turning Davison hostile upon first encounter.

All Bright followers can be killed after Jason Bright is told that the "demons" have been dealt with. As soon as they exit the cell where Jason is located, follow them through the door; Jason himself will not be there (he teleports directly to the basement) and all followers can be safely killed and looted. The same applies to Chris Haversam, who can safely be killed and looted right after confirming that the launch is ready.

For a more violent solution to Manny's request, the ghouls and Chris Haversam can be killed, and Manny will be pleased with the removal of them from the facility. However, the reputation reward for Novac will be less than if the player character completed the quest.
The Nightkin in the basement and Harland can be left alone entirely.

name: Coming Out of Her Shell
reward_text: Variable XP; Dala will serve as 1 of 3 required "votes" for the peaceful ending of Old World BluesEncourage Dala:; Every 24 in-game hours, Dala will gift various energy weapon ammunitionBlackmail Dala:; Every 24 in-game hours, Dala will gift 1 conductor, 1 wonderglue, 10~ pre-War money

stages.description: Get to the bottom of Dala's biological fascination.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Coming Out of Her Shell
Complete Welcome to the Big Empty and speak with Doctor Dala during Picking Your Brains.
Bring Dr. Dala a teddy bear or pass a Perception check of 8, or use Lady Killer/Cherchez La Femme to allow her to "open up" to you.

Reward: Variable XP; Dala will serve as 1 of 3 required "votes" for the peaceful ending of Old World Blues; Encourage Dala: Various energy weapon ammunition every 24 in-game hours; Blackmail Dala: 1 conductor, wonderglue, and pre-War money every 24 in-game hours

notes: Completing this quest before the main quest Old World Blues will cause Doctor Dala to speak up in the Courier's defense against Doctor Klein during that quest's peaceful path (choosing the non-skill dialogue option), serving as 1 of the 3 required "votes" to get the Think Tank leader to back down.

The phrase the Courier speaks at Dala's request, "The quick scribe jumped over the lazy paladin," previously appeared in the Dead Money add-on, spoken by Christine after healing from her surgery to receive Vera Keyes' vocal cords.

rules.note: Dala supplies 1 of 3 votes for the peaceful ending

name: Crazy, Crazy, Crazy
reward_text: 1000 XP; Raul Tejada as a companion (if freed from the prison building)

stages.description: Head to the summit of Black Mountain and end Tabitha's reign of terror.
(Optional) Meet Neil in the village near the summit of Black Mountain.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Crazy, Crazy, Crazy
Speak with Neil.
(Optional) Pass a 50 Speech skill check to convince Neil to; lure the nightkin guards away from the broadcast building.
Follow the road to the peak of Black Mountain.
(Optional) Pass a 75 Speech skill check when using the ham radio beneath the overturned dish to; trick Tabitha into turning the super mutants and nightkin against each other.
Deal with Tabitha.
Access the broadcast building or the prison building to draw out and kill Tabitha.
Pass a 60 Science skill check to repair Rhonda in the storage building.
Reward: 1000 XP; Raul Tejada as a companion (if freed from the prison building)

notes: Tabitha will sometimes spawn outside randomly. If this happens while engaged in combat with the super mutants there, there is no practical way to stop companions from killing her unless entering one of the buildings nearby in time.
Under the toppled satellite dish are several trunks, two of which contain several hundred caps and a third which has an Average-level lock on it.
After passing a certain spot on the road towards Black Mountain, but not yet to Neil's shack, two groups of super mutants will spawn further down the road.

After completing the quest peacefully, Rhonda and Tabitha will make their way down the mountain to Neil's shack, where they will disappear from the game, but they will move very slowly. They can also both be killed and looted with no Karma penalty. Raul can also be freed without Tabitha becoming hostile.

Although Rhonda and Tabitha will be friendly towards the player character if the quest is completed peacefully, they are still allied with the super mutants, nightkin, and centaurs around Black Mountain, who become neutral upon completion. Attacking or killing any Black Mountain inhabitants, even in self-defense, will turn both Tabitha and Rhonda hostile.
If any companions are solely responsible for the kill, Tabitha and Rhonda may only become hostile to them and leave the player character alone.
Freeing Raul first, even without hiring him as a companion will still cause Tabitha to ambush the player character outside.

However, with a high enough sneak skill, one can free Raul and sneak quickly to the storage building to repair Rhonda, causing Tabitha to initiate dialogue upon exiting the building and becoming non-hostile.

If Neil is bypassed via using the Hard-locked gate to reach Tabitha's compound, traveling down to his location afterward will result in him thanking the player character as if they already agreed to help him.
Following the completion of the quest, super mutants and nightkin will still spawn in the area. They will be friendly but cannot be interacted with.
Lily Bowen will have unique dialogue if she is an active companion when completing the quest, regardless of which outcome was chosen.
If Boone is an active companion, he will attack Tabitha on sight due to the NCR's hostility towards super mutants.

There is an unavailable option at the ham radio to tell Tabitha of a dumb-dumb revolt with a lower Speech 40 check, but for that, one must know that Tabitha is paranoid. Since the flag is not set anywhere, this topic never appears.

name: Crush the White Legs
reward_text: Variable XP; Salt-Upon-Wounds' helmet (optional); Salt-Upon-Wounds' power fist (optional); O Daughter of Babylon achievement/trophy

stages.description: Locate the White Legs leader, Salt-Upon-Wounds, and deal with him.
Return to Daniel at the Narrows.

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: Crush the White Legs

notes: Failing the quest will cause Ambassador Crocker and Colonel Moore to be removed from the game world if they are still alive.

As with Beware the Wrath of Caesar!, almost anything can be done against the faction before receiving Crocker's note. As long as the NCR trooper messenger delivering the note is not harmed, faction reputation should be reset to Neutral; if reputation is higher than Neutral, it will not be reset. However, as mentioned above, killing the messenger at any point (even before he gives the message) will fail Don't Tread on the Bear!.

If the Lucky 38 is exited for the first time and the unnamed trooper messenger approaches, it is possible to fast travel before the conversation starts. The trooper will follow the Courier until he is able to deliver his message. This can lead to problems if the trooper follows the player character into areas such as Legion territory, hostile wilderness, or even Nellis Air Force Base, as he may then die to enemies or environmental damage (in the case of Nellis, the artillery barrage). This will fail Don't Tread on the Bear!.

On the "hostile NCR" failure path, it is possible to prevent the appearance of NCR Ranger hit squads when failing this quest by becoming Idolized with the NCR beforehand. This way, failing Don't Tread on the Bear! will result in a Wild Child reputation, higher than the threshold for NCR Ranger hit squads to spawn in the game world.

As noted in the summary, NCR Infamy will not be given if this quest is failed via House or Yes Man (unlike the Legion, the NCR does not consider them hostile). In fact, so long as nothing else is done to antagonize the NCR, it is possible to breach the El Dorado substation and get them to agree to a truce with the Brotherhood of Steel during Wild Card: Side Bets without dropping NCR reputation below Idolized. They will even still accept help in preventing President Kimball's assassination during You'll Know It When It Happens.

Don't Tread on the Bear! is also scripted to fail once President Kimball arrives at Hoover Dam during Arizona Killer. However, by this point in the Legion questline, the quest should have already failed, so the script should not make an impact.

notes: This quest is repeatable once every 24 in-game hours.
The emergency radio can only be used to call for supply support outdoors. It will also not work inside of locations like the Strip or Freeside.

The supply crate always seems to spawn in the same location, in relation to the player character east or northeast of their location, regardless of the direction they are facing. Depending on the direction the player faces, the crate will be facing differently.

If one uses the radio in exactly the same location more than once, the box will spawn in exactly the same location as the previous box, which can lead to the new supply crates becoming unobtainable as they can't be interacted with.

Conversely, supply crates accessed from previous uses of the emergency radio will remain where they spawn indefinitely, allowing one to create safe containers in otherwise scarce areas, or in areas in which all the containers are owned.

notes: One has the option of checking the Mark I Auto-Doc at the New Vegas medical clinic, but a message will explain that despite its similarities to more advanced models (such as the Mark III in Caesar's tent), it is obsolete and shares no compatible parts.

If one attempts to perform the surgery with a Medicine skill level between 25 and 74, Caesar will always die in the same manner as if the option to arrange for him to die was selected. Performing the surgery with a skill level of 24 or lower will result in Caesar's head humorously exploding, offering unique dialogue from an enraged Lucius that will always end with him and the Legion becoming hostile.

Attacking Caesar while he is in his coma will result in him instantly awakening hostile and he will either be stuck standing still or ready to attack the Courier. Punching or shooting Caesar's body after he dies from the surgery will result in everyone in the tent becoming hostile.

It will be impossible to offer Arcade Gannon to Caesar as a slave if he was first recruited after having spoken to Caesar in private. He can still be offered to Lucius once Caesar has gone into his coma, or immediately after killing Caesar in his coma.

If Arcade was lost as a companion by betraying him during For Auld Lang Syne, sometimes the option to sell him into slavery will still be present. By speaking with Caesar and then Lucius, it will be possible to sell Arcade into slavery, despite not having had to leave the tent, or even having access to Arcade. This will give the normal quest reward for selling Arcade into slavery.

If this does not work, one can alternatively progress For Auld Lang Syne up to being required to go to the Remnants bunker to meet with the Enclave veterans, then dismiss Arcade to the Lucky 38 before entering the bunker. Once the quest is finished, travel to the Lucky 38 and meet Arcade, he will still be available to be recruited as a companion and can still be sold into slavery to Caesar. This allows one to both get the Enclave remnants to fight for the Legion and have Arcade cure Caesar's tumor, which is normally impossible to do in the same playthrough as either action will result in Arcade leaving the player.

To garner the most NCR fame this method, it is advisable to accept the quest in its first stage (planting the bug and stealing the intel) before killing the legionnaires. One can then kill everyone in the camp and still place the bug and steal the intel. When returning to Astor, "I killed everyone in the camp," should not be selected, and instead, the "[Give intel]" option should be. This will progress until "Is there anything else you need done?" becomes available, at which point Astor will mention cleaning out the camp and one can say they already have done so. This results in the full reputation gain possible.
Astor will have unique dialogue if the player character is female and completes the additional objective by directly attacking and killing the legionnaires at Cottonwood Cove.

If the radioactive barrels are released into Cottonwood Cove before freeing the Weathers family from captivity, the quest Left My Heart will fail. The Weathers can be found in a locked pen behind the storage building. They are wearing slave collars that need to either be safely removed, maliciously detonated or provided with the key, in which case they will unlock themselves and escape. However, Anders, who needs to be freed as part of Aba Daba Honeymoon, is far enough away not to be harmed by the radiation.

It is possible to complete this quest and eradicate the entire camp without incurring Legion infamy; if one wears Caesar's Legion armor, makes Boone wait at Ranger Station Echo nearby, and utilizes the radioactive barrels to eliminate the Legion soldiers. This results in no reputation loss for dropping the barrels into Cottonwood Cove if remaining undetected.

If one stays near the cove after dropping the barrels, they can observe most of the non-unique Legion troops running up to the barrels and dying in a group. The named ones will simply die on the spot.
Killing the legionaries in Cottonwood Cove, and then releasing the barrels will still give the extra NCR fame.

If the radioactive barrels have been released, the ferry can still be used to reach Caesar's camp. The Legion ferryman, Cursor Lucullus, will now be wearing a radiation suit and will still grant access to the Fort.

notes: When using O'Hanrahan's method, it can happen that the new dialogue options to be buried in conversation paths that one has already taken. Some dialogue will have to be repeated with Poindexter, Mags and Razz in order to obtain the new Speech options.
The Speech check is after the player character asks them about their squadmates, which is always the second line in the dialogue choice box.

Once the player character chooses a suggested method, another cannot be picked up; e.g. if the player character starts with Mags and cannot pass the required skill checks for her route, it is not possible to pick up the quest arc with Poindexter until the first quest arc is completed.

If the player character uses Mags' method to train the troops' skill with weapons, they cannot do so if the squad's rifles have been removed from their inventories. If this happens, the troops will immediately go to using grenades and the quest won't be able to complete.

It is possible to earn the XP from using O'Hanrahan's method by passing all three Speech checks, then, instead of returning to O'Hanrahan to finish the quest, agree to use Mags' method of training the squad at the firing range to get the XP for the Guns and Explosives skill checks.
After the quest is completed, Mr. New Vegas may be heard talking on Radio New Vegas about how a "young band of soldiers shattered NCR records on a combat readiness assessment at Camp Golf."

During Mags' route, when the squad is training with grenades and Mags says that they have the dummy grenades ready, they appear to throw live grenades, but a check of their inventory shows they are coded to only do 1 damage.
Upon fast-traveling to Camp Golf, a lakelurk may spawn near or at the firing range. This can lead to Misfits squad members being killed, which results in quest failure.
If the player character travels to Camp Golf from the southwest, the Misfits can come under attack by legionary assassins and be killed.

Reward: 500 XP; Remnants power armor; Gannon family Tesla armor (if the Remnants support the NCR and Arcade returns to Freeside); Power Armor Training (if not already gained); The Enclave remnants appear during the Second Battle of Hoover Dam; Arcade Gannon permanently leaves as a companion

notes: It is possible to complete For Auld Lang Syne, even in the Legion's favor, without losing Arcade as a permanent companion. Simply tell Arcade to wait at the Lucky 38 after recruiting the remnants, but before entering the bunker. Arcade should still be waiting at the Lucky 38 upon finishing the quest. Note that using this exploit results in the Gannon Family Tesla armor becoming unobtainable, and Arcade Gannon's ending will be absent, unless he is sold to the Legion as a slave during Et Tumor, Brute?.

Completing this quest is one of three ways to gain the Power Armor Training perk, the others being Eyesight to the Blind or Tend to Your Business, albeit the latter two are mutually exclusive and depend on the outcome of the side quest Still in the Dark and who is picked as the Brotherhood of Steel elder.

Completing this quest results in the Enclave remnants being air dropped into Hoover Dam about halfway into the final battle, except for Daisy Whitman (who pilots the vertibird) and Arcade (who is either helping a pair of NCR heavy troopers fight Legionaries in the Hoover Dam visitor center, staying at the Old Mormon Fort assisting the Followers, or has left the player character if they sided with the Legion.)

Doctor Henry joins as a temporary companion, while Orion Moreno stays behind and holds the position. Either Judah Kreger or Cannibal Johnson will also follow as a temporary companion depending on if the remnants are supporting the Legion or NCR respectively. In the NCR's case, Kreger will remain to hold the position by himself, or alongside Moreno if the latter was convinced to fight. They will always stay friendly with the faction they were told to support.

Attacking the remnants while inside their bunker turns them hostile, except for Doctor Henry, who will instead stand in the same spot inside of the Remnants bunker command room for the remainder of the game.
Turning the inhabitants of Jacobstown hostile will fail the quest, even if all of the remnants have been recruited and are inside of the bunker.
Progressing this quest is the only way to open the Remnants bunker without the use of console commands.

If the Courier tells Judah Kreger to assist the Legion, does not interact with Orion Moreno to receive the Enclave power armor, and kills Arcade Gannon (after permanently leaving the Courier), the quest will fail.
On PC, the amount of like and dislike points for Arcade Gannon can be seen by using the console commands and .
These values can be changed via the commands or .

Arcade can still start the quest for the player even as late as the SYS save on a Legion-aligned character. This can be achieved by uploading Yes Man to the Lucky 38's mainframe, then starting the Beware the Wrath of Caesar! quest. Travelling to the Old Mormon Fort and equipping any clothing item that is NCR affiliated will allow the Low Intelligence, Speech, or Confirmed Bachelor check required to get Arcade to follow. As soon as he accepts, open the Pip-Boy and unequip the armor, then fast travel to The Fort in the same action. Dialogue will open following this, so select the option "Let's just go in, see what he has to say, and get out." Afterward, Arcade will start the quest For Auld Lang Syne, and will not disband from the player through the entirety of the quest.

notes: The Courier may not be able to save Kimball, if they decide to go the Wild Card route, but do not have a good reputation with the NCR. As they are about to complete the game as a Wild Card, they may speak to Yes Man and he will inform them that the president may be assassinated. Two options to choose from will appear in a message box, one stating that the player character has no good relations with NCR and the other, that they do not care what happens to Kimball. There is no third option to back out and try to save him later. This will automatically fail the "You'll Know It When It Happens" quest. When one reaches the point in For the Republic to save the president, both the colonel and Grant will act as if he's alive, even when the NCR troops around state that he is already assassinated. One may then meet Grant outside, when the president is about to arrive and nothing will happen. One must then leave the Dam, and the quest will update to report back to the colonel and tell her that Kimball is dead. This will unlock the achievement for completing the quest, even though Kimball has been dead before starting the quest.

One cannot work for both Yes Man and Colonel Moore for this quest. Getting "You'll Know When It Happens" from Yes Man BEFORE getting it from Colonel Moore, will force one to play the rest of the game as a Wild Card rather than working for the NCR. In this case, Colonel Moore will ask the player character to protect President Kimball, but Ranger Grant will not respond to any attempts to talk, therefore the quest cannot be completed. An easy way to avoid this is to ignore Yes Man completely, therefore preventing him from triggering the quest before it is desired by the Courier.

There is a way around this on the pc. While looking at Grant, press the (tilde) key to enter the console, then click on Grant and type , then and exit the console by pressing tilde again, and Grant should start talking.

If the player character already received the quest Beware the Wrath of Caesar! prior due to completing Wild Card: Change in Management for Yes Man's quest line, Beware the Wrath of Caesar! may fail upon speaking to Colonel Moore about the Omertas after completing Oh My Papa. Even if one has a positive reputation with Caesar's Legion, one's reputation will decrease significantly and Caesar's Legion will still become hostile regardless of the resulting reputation.
Sometimes one can walk around the counter to Grant and he will initiate a conversation about protecting the president, even if the quest was received from Yes Man before talking to the Colonel.

Completion of The House Always Wins IV (or higher) will result in this mission being failed. Note that if one has already completed "How Little We Know" when completing "The House Always Wins III", then part IV will automatically be completed and this mission will be failed.
Upon destroying the Hidden Valley bunker, the dust storm generator is disabled and smoke will start rising from the air vents around the bunker area.

By passing a Speech check (75), one can provoke Karl intro revealing his real thoughts about the Khans in front of Papa Khan, which leads to Papa Khan and the other Khans in the room killing him. However, the Oh My Papa quest line still requires talking with all the above non-player characters to be completed.

If one has already completed Oh My Papa and convinced the Great Khans to leave the Mojave, one will immediately be given a dialogue option; "The Khans won't be troubling anyone anymore.", as soon as the quest starts.

Managing to ally the Brotherhood of Steel with the NCR will result in the player incurring some NCR infamy, but it will not be enough to lower one's actual reputation level with NCR, assuming one has not gained other instances of NCR infamy beforehand.

When speaking to a member of the NCR, they will mention Colonel Moore has accepted the Brotherhood of Steel's offer to aid them in battle, even if the player character has not yet spoken to her about it.

If he survives and is hired a second time, he will lead to the final ambush, though this time the four dead thugs won't be there to help him.
Using Turbo as Orris runs ahead results in watching the thugs 'die' as one of them falls to the ground before Orris starts shooting.

While the NCR troopers are shooting at Pacer, they will not be present in the ruined store, nor will any of the squatters from the NCR. After the shootout, if still alive, the NCR will return to the building.
After resolving the fight peacefully, attempting to have a conversation with the NCR troopers while they are walking away will result in the same dialogue as if they are in their original locations.
Killing Pacer during the mission will result in failing the quest.

If one completed Heartache by the Number with Cass beforehand, when following Orris through the gate to Freeside, the Silver Rush crier will attack the player character just after passing through the divider gate. If the crier dies, no Karma will be lost but it will cause Simon to turn hostile as well as draw out the rest of the Van Graff guards from the Silver Rush to attack.

notes: It is possible to kill Joe Cobb before the final attack by the Powder Gangers, and several Goodsprings residents will comment on it. This will reduce the number of Powder Ganger attackers to five. In this situation, Sunny Smiles will erroneously say that there are still at least six Powder Gangers coming to attack, but this is incorrect, as no NPC will spawn to replace Joe Cobb.
There is an additional generic Powder Ganger placed with the others, but his reference is disabled and unused by the game.
Ringo will not accept the player character's offer to help him if they have a negative reputation with Goodsprings, thus rendering the quest impossible to complete.

If the player character does not personally kill any Powder Gangers during the fight or performs only stealth kills, the most negative reputation they can earn with the Powder Gangers is a Shunned reputation, which is not low enough to cause any Powder Ganger locations to be hostile to the player character, should one also wish to enter the NCR Correctional Facility and complete I Fought the Law for Eddie.

Alternatively, one could complete that quest first, then return to Goodsprings to complete this quest. However, leaving Goodsprings triggers the one-time menus for redoing the Courier's SPECIALS, Skills, etc. However, before telling Ringo the fight is on, a player character could leave and return to Goodsprings since a redo of specs should not affect the final gunfight.
Using a weapon that inflicts Fatigue damage to knock out Powder Gangers is a way to help Goodsprings win the fight without earning a Vilified reputation with the Powder Gangers.
If one steals the single shotgun found in one of the houses in Goodsprings before entering the gunfight, Trudy will not have a weapon in the fight.
When attacking Joe Cobb, he may run into Easy Pete's house to hide.
The roof of the Prospector Saloon can be reached using the wooden barrels and crates nearby and offers a good vantage point during the fight.
If the player character shoots any Goodsprings residents during the fight, everyone on their side will turn hostile after defeating the Powder Gangers unless the player's gun is holstered.

Both Ringo and Joe Cobb will talk about Ringo's relative safety hiding out, saying that Ringo could shoot Cobb through the windows. However, the windows on the outside of the gas station are boarded up, and there are no windows in the interior of the gas station through which Ringo could shoot or see anyone coming.

notes: It is possible to finish the quest peacefully, then kill both of the targets, causing Cass to end up with both unique perks.

Note: The GECK scripts appear to take away the Calm Heart perk when the Hand of Vengeance perk is granted, but it appears that companion perks are handled specially - in-game testing shows that she keeps both perks.
It is possible to finish the quest by killing Cass and returning to the Van Graffs. However, if this is done without hiding, or using a stealthy method, NCR infamy will be incurred.
If Ranger Jackson is dead when one suggests finding evidence to give to the NCR, Cass will decline and one will be forced to follow the violent route.

Despite Ranger Jackson warning not to kill McLafferty or Van Graff, or he'll "put you in chains," if one then kills both or either one of them and then returns to the Mojave Outpost, speaking to Jackson does not trigger any negative consequences.

It is not possible to complete this quest and Birds of a Feather in the same playthrough, as Cass will be killed in that quest, whereas killing Gloria Van Graff or Jean-Baptiste Cutting will fail Birds of a Feather.

If one completed Still in the Dark by helping Edgar Hardin usurp Nolan McNamara to become the Brotherhood of Steel's elder, one can complete the subsequent quest Tend to Your Business and the violent path of this quest simultaneously as that quest solely requires wiping out the Van Graffs by any means.

Killing Alice McLafferty will fail both You Can Depend on Me and the subsequent quest Pressing Matters (though it is possible to complete both before completing this quest for all three sources of XP).

It is possible to kill the Van Graffs first by presenting Cass to them as requested, then objecting when they try to kill her. This method will still allow one to turn in the evidence from Alice McLafferty to Ranger Jackson, and complete the peaceful option.

If one has already killed Gloria and the Van Graff family, after going into the Silver Rush with Cass and getting the evidence from the safe, when talking to her and trying to show her the evidence, she will go on about doing it the old fashioned way, and the marker will lead one to Alice to kill her. If one ignores that and still report to Ranger Jackson, he will accept the evidence, and will complete the quest peacefully, gaining the Calm Heart perk. The ranger will also lead to the quest Can You Find it in Your Heart?

If working towards the peaceful solution and then either change one's mind or alienate the NCR (which makes the peaceful solution unreachable), one can switch to the violent solution simply by killing either Gloria Van Graff or Alice McLafferty. One cannot make this switch through dialogue; just kill the targets to make the switch. Cass will ask to let her know next time the Courier wants to change their mind.

If one has accepted Heartache by the Number but haven't picked up Cass as a companion, and one talks to her after having killed Gloria for unrelated reasons, it will trigger the final phase of the quest; she will rejoice over Van Graff's death out of the blue and propose to go settle the score with McLafferty.
After completing the quest with the peaceful route, the Van Graffs will permanently turn hostile. On PC, it is possible to make them neutral by inputting the console command SetAlly 1b2a4 118368 1 1.

Simply selecting the ARCHIMEDES II option from the list is enough to complete this quest stage, and the player can then divert the power elsewhere.

notes: If the player's game suffers severe frame drops while trying to defeat the Legion at Bitter Springs, it is best to intercept each of the three Legion waves before they enter Bitter Springs. Be sure to not enter Bitter Springs, as this may cause the low frame rates to worsen. The best way to accomplish this is to shoot at each wave so that they notice the Courier and stop running towards the town. This takes some strategic positioning to pull off, as the last wave has a head start by the graves on the other side of the town. An alternate strategy is to plant a bunch of C4 and mines by the graves where the third wave spawns and blow them up as they run by.

It is possible for either Lieutenant Markland or Captain Gilles to die during the quest, particularly if one is not quick in intercepting the Legion raiders. This will fail the associated quests No, Not Much, Bitter Springs Infirmary Blues and Climb Ev'ry Mountain. The presence of refugees and NCR soldiers also make friendly fire a problem, especially with explosive weapons.

After completing the quest, Mr. New Vegas will report the incident on Radio New Vegas, mentioning that two civilians repelled an entire Legion raiding force, and in an interview, a civilian witness said that "God sent us two angels, and at least one of them had a .308 caliber flaming sword of justice with a telescopic sight." He will say this even if Boone doesn't use his rifle and is equipped with another weapon during the quest.

If one tells Boone to go to Bitter Springs on his own, he will become angry and will abandon the player character. If one interacts with Boone again, he will take them back but will be upset about the previous conversation's conclusion.

Having the Animal Friend perk makes the dogs in the Legion raiding party non-hostile toward the player character and Boone (and ED-E or Rex, if present), but they will still be hostile toward other NPCs and must be killed to complete the quest.
If one kills Boone at any time before completing the quest, Mr. New Vegas will mention that Bitter Springs was attacked by a Legion raiding party and wiped out.
With patch 1.4.0.525, it is not possible to enter the interrogation room containing Silus with a non-holdout weapon even after the interrogation is over, though this can happen without the patch.

notes: It is possible to kill all the Powder Gangers before the assault on the prison (including Eddie) and complete the quest (by implementing sneak kills with a silenced weapon to avoid Powder Gangers infamy, then kill Eddie when one is told to report to Sergeant Lee - reporting back to Sergeant Lee after killing Eddie will generate an automatic mission success).
Killing Eddie prior to that point will fail the quest.

By doing this, it is also possible to gain the rewards for helping Eddie (300 XP instead of the normal 200), only become shunned (Powder Ganger camps will not attack the player character) by the Powder Gangers (See Notes) and gain the reputation increase with the NCR. First, betray Eddie to Hayes. Then, instead of talking to Lee outside of the prison, head on in. Speak to Eddie prior to killing him and let him know about the attack, stealth kill him and equip NCR faction armor (armor optional), then run outside and through the visitor's center to speak with Lee as he is running (from the left) inside. Keep running after speaking to him and over the ridge if one lacks NCR faction armor. He will reward only NCR reputation and not Powder Ganger infamy, as the latter would normally occur at this point but does no due to turning the quest in first to Eddie. Similarly, the player character gains the 300 XP for the NCR completion even though the quest is finished by Eddie.

However, if the player character uses the above method, all the NCR troopers inside the administration center will be hostile to them from that point on (even days or weeks later) if they ever enter the area without an NCR faction disguise equipped.
Powder Gangers in the scattered camps are hostile to the player character until one reputation is neutral or at least Shunned, so avoid killing them loudly to be able to speak to Eddie initially.

It is possible to talk to Eddie without a Stealth Boy, even if one is vilified by the Powder Gangers. The easiest way to do this is to kill Powder Gangers who can see through disguises (Dawes, Carter, Hannigan, bodyguards, etc), and stealthily kill all other Powder Gangers (Not necessary to kill Meyers). One may need to remove and then put the Powder Gangers faction armor back on to reset rep back to neutral, and also wait around until they no longer sense the player character, so they no longer appear as hostile. Using this technique, one can get rid of every Powder Ganger at the NCR Correctional Facility except for Eddie and Meyers. Then, every time one wants to talk to Eddie, run in and talk to him before he has a chance to get up. When dialogue ends, run out of the room so he cannot see the player character and turn hostile. One can also try to sneak behind the computer on his desk and back away.

Killing all of Eddie's guards stealthily may allow one to get to Eddie and initiate dialogue without hostilities, as a workaround for the above issue. If he becomes hostile when approached after his guards are dead, try running quickly at him and repeatedly trying to talk. If the player character gets to him before he stands up, he will talk to them. Also, one can sneak behind the computer on his desk after the talk, back away to the wall, then stand up and walk away.

If one wants to help the Powder Gangers or sit back and let the NCR and Gangers fight it out (without betraying them), it is recommended that one visits the Cell Blocks and the Visitor Center, so that more Gangers will join the battle. This will lead to a slightly more even fight.

If one wants to be certain to complete the quest, (and not intervene), one will have to visit each cell block, otherwise the NCR will just kill the Powder Gangers in the yard, then the Admin building. After Eddie is killed the NCR troops will go into idle mode and walk around the building leaving the Powder Gangers alive in other buildings. One named Powder Ganger may remain in one of the cell blocks, (a sneak kill if one wants to keep their rep intact).
If one has low Intelligence when reporting to Eddie after dealing with the bounty hunter, the player character will say "I got rid of the bunny hunter."

Although the player character can pickpocket the attack orders from Lt. Hayes before the quest, they will still be unable to initiate the attack on the Powder Gangers or speak to Hayes about the attack at all until the one is given the choice during the quest (this also mean the player character cannot complete this quest if they are hated by the Powder Gangers).

notes: The timer to make Lily play her holotape is set on the first time that the player enters the sleep/wait menu after fulfilling the three conditions. Furthermore, the timer works by taking a float value fRestTimer based on the exact time that that sleep/wait menu is activated, and then playing the holotape once the current time of day becomes greater than the value of fRestTimer. Since Fallout: New Vegas uses a 24-hour clock, this means that a player who chooses to wait for an hour at 23:30 will not be able to hear the recording at least until 23:31 on the following game day. This can make the recording very hard to trigger without knowing exactly what time the timer was set to.

Thus, once the three dialogue conditions are fulfilled, not entering the sleep or wait menu until after midnight (when the time value resets to 0) is the most reliable way to make sure the recording will play.
Since it is not possible to sleep or wait to let the time pass, another method to trigger the event is to fast travel to different locations to make the time pass faster.

notes: If one assassinates Papa Khan and has not yet completed Why Can't We Be Friends?, that quest will instantly fail.

If, at the end of the quest, one asks Papa Khan to ally with the NCR and then tells him to stick around, the quest will remain open for the player character to solve via talking to Regis/Colonel Moore and assassinating Papa Khan.

If all the commanders in Camp Forlorn Hope are assassinated for the corresponding Legion quest, Papa Khan will inform the player character that upon his death they will become the new chief. Simply stealth kill Papa when he goes to bed, report to Regis and tell him who the Khans are to ally with (i.e. NCR, Legion or independent). This will result in Great Khans fame and Papa Khan's unique armor to loot.

Halfway through the quest, one may be randomly attacked several times by two recruit legionaries who say "Karl sends his regards" if one fast travels to and from the Red Rock location. They hide behind rocks at the bottom of the hill to the longhouse.

It is still possible, albeit difficult, to get the Legion slave ledger if they are hostile to the player character. Legion armor can be used without problem up until one enters the drawbridge to the inner camp. At that point getting caught by a Legion guard or mongrel on the way to the tent, turning the entire Fort hostile, is nearly inevitable. One solution is to use Turbo, though one will need several to make it all the way in and out. A Stealth Boy or the stealth suit Mk II are also viable and will even help one sneak through the tent, in front of Caesar, Vulpes Inculta, Lucius and the guards.
One can turn in the journal and if they quickly go talk to Karl before the Great Khans kill him, one can still do the Speech checks.
A neutral reputation can enable one to do this quest even if they are Vilified by the Great Khans.

If the player character has completed Don't Make a Beggar of Me and cannot find Melissa, they can still complete the quest by assassinating Papa Khan and having Regis side with the NCR. (One may first need to speak with Col. Moore about the possible allegiance to activate this branch of the quest).
If one's infamy with the Great Khans is too high, then one will not get the dialogue option from Colonel Moore to assassinate Papa Khan, and assassinating him anyway will not advance the quest.

This quest is still available for if one has or is planning to join the Legion; however, while the quest does not grant Infamy for Caesar's Legion, there are still consequences for completion, such as not receiving support during Veni, Vidi, Vici. In addition, completing the quest while working on Legion affiliated quests, especially during Render Unto Caesar, Caesar, when spoken to next time, will react with anger and berate the player character for forcing the Khans to break up their alliance with Caesar.
When asking Papa Khan to break his alliance with the Legion, one might have to select the second option (Caesar will enslave the Khans) in order to start the quest.

name: Restoring Hope
reward_text: 300 XP; NCR fame; Liberator (optional)

stages.description: Talk to Quartermaster Mayes
Go to HELIOS One to ask about Forlorn Hope supplies
Follow the GPS marker to the Forlorn Hope supplies
Return the supplies to Quartermaster Mayes
Speak to Major Polatli
Meet with Dr. Richards
Help Dr. Richards with his patients
Help Dr. Richard find missing hydra
Return to Major Polatli
Meet Sergeant Cooper
Defeat the Legion at Nelson
Tell Polatli about the victory at Nelson.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Restoring Hope
Speak with Major Polatli in the command center at Camp Forlorn Hope;; ask what he needs help with.
Speak with Quartermaster Mayes; in the quartermaster's tent south of the command center.
Reach HELIOS One and speak with Lieutenant Haggerty about the missing Forlorn Hope supplies.
Reach the location of the supplies and retrieve the Camp Forlorn Hope supply shipment.
Return the shipment to Mayes and then speak with Polatli.
Complete additional objectives around Camp Forlorn Hope to raise "camp morale" (see below).
Speak with Dr. Richards in the medical center and assist with healing his patients.
Return to Polatli.
Speak with Sgt. Cooper outside Nelson to assault the Legion garrison and kill Dead Sea.
Return to Major Polatli.
Reward: 300 XP; NCR fame; Liberator (optional)

notes: This quest serves as a counterpart to the Legion side quest We Are Legion; finishing either will always cause the other to fail. For example, this quest requires the death of Dead Sea who gives We Are Legion and vice-versa with Major Polatli.

The supply shipment from HELIOS One can be found before Restoring Hope is started, meaning one can find the supplies before starting the quest, then immediately give them to Mayes and return to Maj. Polatli to continue the quest as normal.

If Lt. Haggerty was killed before starting the quest, although the map marker will point to the empty space where she normally stands, as with the above note, the supply shipment can still be found and the quest continued by going east of HELIOS One and retrieving it.
One can finish the side quest Back in Your Own Backyard alongside Restoring Hope by helping the crucified NCR troopers during the assault and then going to Ranger Milo to the southeast afterward.

If the player character has killed every Legion character in Nelson before they finish aiding Dr. Richards, the quest will complete upon reporting to Major Polatli, since Nelson has already been freed from Legion control. This works if the player character defeats the Legion even before receiving the quest.

It is possible to complete the quest without gaining Legion infamy or failing Beware the Wrath of Caesar!. The hardest part is the house with Dead Sea in it. Crouch and enter after using a Stealth Boy. They have a very low Perception, and as long as they do not notice the Courier upon entering, they will remain friendly. Go straight into the washing room and one can easily take them out with a silenced weapon. Alternatively, if they see the Courier, run outside and they will give chase, at which point they will be gunned down by the NCR. The moment the NCR soldiers tied on the cross are rescued, Legion infamy is gained, even if none of the Legionnaires are still alive to witness it.
Wearing Caesar's Legion armor while performing a silent/hidden kill on Dead Sea will help avoid garnering Legion infamy.

After picking up the quartermaster's supply shipment, Legionary ambushers will spawn that attack the player regardless of their faction reputation. Wearing Caesar's Legion armor or using a Stealth Boy will also prevent them from becoming hostile.

rules.note: Each requires the death of the other's quest giver

name: Retake the Bridge
reward_text: Variable XP

stages.description: Defeat the White Legs holding the bridge to Pine Creek.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Retake the Bridge
Start the main quest Flight from Zion;; reach the East Fork Bridge.
200px
(Optional) Disarm all bear traps on the bridge.
Attack and kill all White Legs on the bridge.
