notes: Occasionally, the Courier will arrive to find the White Legs dead and 1-2 injured green geckos.

It is possible to lead the White Legs through their own bear traps. Getting them to trigger the traps in this way apparently does not affect the optional part of the quest, but any that were not triggered can still be disarmed and fulfill the optional portion.

name: Return to Sender
reward_text: 500–800 XP; NCR fame; Ranger Sequoia (optional)

stages.description: Deliver the radio security upgrade codes to each of the Ranger Stations.
Return to Sergeant Reyes and let her know the radio security upgrade is complete.
Find out what else Sergeant Reyes needs you to do.
Confirm Sergeant Reyes' suspicions about the reports from Camp Golf.
Ask Ranger Lineholm about the battle losses at Ranger Station Alpha.
Find out about the Super Mutant Legionary attack at Ranger Station Delta.
Investigate the Deathclaw attacks on Ranger Station Foxtrot.
Tell Sergeant Reyes that her suspicions about misinformation being fed to the NCR was correct.
Inform Chief Hanlon what you and Sergeant Reyes discovered.
Speak to Chief Hanlon in his office.
Find a ranger to take Chief Hanlon into custody.
Kill Chief Hanlon

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Return to Sender
Reach Camp Forlorn Hope and speak with Sgt. Reyes in the command center;; agree to help deliver the Ranger station radio codes.
Reach Ranger Stations Alpha, Bravo, Charlie, Delta, Echo, and Foxtrot; to deliver the new radio codes to the station comms officers.
Return to Reyes.
Go back to Ranger Stations Alpha, Delta, and Foxtrot to investigate the suspicious reports.
Return to Reyes again.
Reach Camp Golf and speak with Chief Hanlon about the falsified reports.
Follow Hanlon to his office inside the House Resort.
Agree to keep quiet about Hanlon's sabotage.
Convince Hanlon to turn himself in.
Attack and kill Hanlon.
Reward: 500–800 XP; NCR fame; Hanlon dies: Ranger Sequoia (optional)

notes: According to in-game files, there is an existing dialogue option whereby Hanlon could be convinced to stop falsifying the reports if the Courier had learned about Caesar's illness. However, since the only way to learn of Caesar's illness is to advance far enough into the Render Unto Caesar quest that the NCR would already be hostile and it would impossible to advance their quests, making the option extremely difficult to get should the player wish to side with the NCR.

For a while, this was believed to be a bug in the game, as Silus can give a hint towards Caesar's illness if he is beaten into talking in Silus Treatment.(Silus' dialogue) However, this was later proven false, as the dialogue option with Hanlon is impossible to activate, as evident by its peripherals in the game's code.
This option is possible to obtain if Caesar is killed in The Fort before talking to Hanlon. However, it also unlocks the option to convince him with Caesar's death, making it obsolete.

There is also an ending the player can obtain which requires Hanlon to be convinced to stop falsifying the records, completing Veni, Vidi, Vici, while Caesar is still alive while Et Tumor, Brute? is active. It can be presumed that the requirements to meet this ending are to learn of Caesar's illness and inform Hanlon that way, having disguised oneself in NCR armor in order to prevent hostility. But due to the dialogue option being cut, the ending is impossible to obtain. Under such circumstances, Hanlon gets beheaded if Caesar survives his tumor, while he gets crucified if Caesar dies and Lanius takes command of the Legion.

It is possible for a ranger to be present in the room across the hall from Hanlon's office, meaning if the option to turn him in is chosen, one can do as Hanlon asks and get a ranger without getting far enough from Hanlon for the door to shut. However, there is no scenario where Hanlon lives after being turned in, so it will be useless.
Hanlon will refuse to discuss the falsified reports unless he is already seated on the balcony.

If playing in favor of Caesar's Legion, this quest can still be completed alongside We Are Legion (which requires killing all senior officers in Forlorn Hope, one of them being Sergeant Reyes). To be able to do this, upgrade the ranger stations and double-check the intel reports, then kill all the officers and, at the same time, talk with chief Hanlon, which will successfully complete this quest.

If one convinces Hanlon to stop falsifying reports, the quest will be completed. However, Tech Sergeant Reyes can still updated on the situation, either lied to that a Legion spy was responsible, told the truth that it was Hanlon, or simply be told to forget about it and that it is over. This last option is only available after convincing Hanlon to stop falsifying reports through killing Caesar, and also has no audio. Neither option results in any extra rewards or consequences.

name: Ring-a-Ding-Ding!
reward_text: 1000 XP; Achievement / Trophy

stages.description: Search The Strip for the man who shot you.
Confront Benny at The Tops casino.
Go to the presidential suite (or kill Benny).
Survive the ambush (or recover the platinum chip).
Search Benny's suite.

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: Ring-a-Ding-Ding!
Reach the Tops casino on the New Vegas Strip.
Pass 3 Speech checks (15/30/45) or present pieces of evidence to Swank at the reception desk.
Confront Benny on the gambling floor.
Search Benny's suite on the Tops' 13th floor.
Kill Benny and take the platinum chip.
Use the Black Widow perk to seduce Benny.
Go to the Tops presidential suite with or without Benny.
Talk to Yes Man about Benny's plan and the platinum chip.
Kill Benny in his sleep or leave him alone.
Survive the ambush by Chairman bodyguards.
Leave the Tops casino.
Reward: 1000 XP; Achievement/Trophy
Leads to: Things That Go Boom, Render Unto Caesar, The House Always Wins II, Wild Card: Change in Management

notes: If the player did not retrieve their weapons before entering the presidential suite, there are weapons in the suite.

There is an average locked safe along the left most wall of the presidential suite bar that contains a 10mm submachine gun, a grenade rifle, and a power fist along with some ammunition. There is only a small amount of ammunition in the safe, so bringing additional ammunition is advised.
There are two pool cues in full condition on the billiard tables closest to the safe.

Using the dialogue option to forgive Benny or sleeping with Benny are the only ways to unlock access to the sub-basement level of The Tops, as the sub-basement elevator is automatically unlocked once Benny begins to leave the casino. After this happens Benny can be killed, if still present, without removing access to the sub-basement.

With a Lockpick skill of 100, it is possible to break inside the bank and retrieve the player's equipment from the weapons locker. This unlocks additional dialogue when first speaking to Benny on the casino floor.Benny: "You want a reason, how about four? They're called bodyguards, and every one of them is packing. Me, too - so baby makes five. Add to that every Chairman in this joint is armed, and not with some hold-out peashooter like maybe you smuggled through security. Anything I needed to worry about, baby, got confiscated at the door."; The Courier: "Maybe that's why I broke into the weapons locker."; Benny: "You're bluffing, baby... Except maybe you're not. Sweet little caper, getting your weapons back. But let cooler heads prevail, hey? No need for violence."; Benny's dialogue
It is possible to skip this quest and continue with the main story line. This is done by siding with the NCR, since Ambassador Crocker's note can be received before completing Ring-a-ding-ding!

It's possible to fail Beware the Wrath of Caesar! before confronting Benny by advancing far enough through For the Republic, Part 2. Because confronting Benny causes Vulpes Inculta (or Alerio if Vulpes was previously killed) to approach the Courier, the player will not receive the mark of Caesar. Travel to the Fort will be possible as Cursor Lucullus is scripted separately from them, but the Legion will be hostile.
If the player has sex with Benny and then chooses the option to kill him in his sleep, this will not add to the 'people killed' statistic.
During this quest, it is possible to steal the gun Maria from Benny, and kill him with it. This will complete the two star Gun Runner's Arsenal challenge Talk About Owned.
If Swank is convinced to return the player's weapons to them, their weapons will never be confiscated when entering the Tops after completing the quest.

Before leaving the presidential suite after surviving the ambush, Benny can be spoken to over the intercom. Benny initially assumes that he is speaking to one of the bodyguards he sent to kill the player, giving them instructions to wait for the cleaners to arrive, and reacts in shock once he realises that the player survived.The Courier: "Yeah, it's a real mess here - four bodies."; Benny: "What the fuck...?"; Benny's dialogue
If Benny is killed, Swank becomes the new leader of the Chairmen, and the platinum chip is recovered.
If Benny escapes with the chip, he will later be caught by the Legion and can be found at the Fort.

One will always get the Tops presidential suite key, either during the quest or by finding it on Benny's corpse. The presidential suite is considered player housing, and has safe storage containers, but has no crafting workbenches.
Speaking with Yes Man will trigger the start of the Wild Card quest chain.

If Gathering Storms is completed while Rite of Passage is ongoing, the effect will be canceled and the quest failed. However, the normal message telling the player that they have failed a quest does not appear.
The effect of drinking White Bird's tea, explicitly said to be made with sacred datura root, causes an effect that differs from that of regular datura poison.

According to Joshua Sawyer, while the creature named the Ghost of She is real, its strange physical characteristics like being perpetually ablaze are potentially a result of the player being under the influence of a datura derived drug.
The quest cannot be completed after completing the Honest Hearts storyline as White Bird, along with all other non-hostile NPCS, will disappear from Zion Canyon.
When talking to White Bird for the first time, asking what he is talking about will cause him to reply "Take drugs. Kill a bear." This is a reference to the "Advice Animals" internet meme.

reward_text: Variable XP

stages.description: Deal with the Yao Guai at Pine Creek.
Optional: Collapse the Yao Guai Cave

Leave the cave and set off the charges with the mining detonator.
Optional: Kill the Yao Guai at Pine Creek.

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: River Monsters

Enter the cave and place mining explosives in the marked spots, then exit and use Daniel's mining detonator to seal the cave.

notes: It is possible to kill the yao guai in the cave before this quest starts, though they may respawn once it does. If they do not, the only way to complete the quest is to plant the explosives and seal the cave.
Once the explosives are set off, the yao guai cave will be permanently inaccessible for the rest of the game.

The mining explosives are not a traditional explosive that can be carried; instead, they are a part of the cave and only need to be enabled at the marked points. When spawned, they are visually identical to C-4 plastic explosives.

It is possible to complete both optional parts of the quest, but it requires good timing. After killing the third and final yao guai, it is possible to quickly switch to the detonator and collapse the cave, requiring placing the explosives previously. However, this will not give any extra rewards.
The layout and goal of this quest is similar to Stop the Radscorpions from Fallout.

name: Rotface's Loose Lips
reward_text: Clues to quests and characters around New Vegas

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: Rotface's Loose Lips
Speak with Rotface in Freeside near the east gate.
Pay 1 cap each to hear a tip about places or people around New Vegas.
Reward: Clues to quests and characters around New Vegas

notes: Getting a tip from Rotface will not actually trigger any quests related to them, nor provide a map marker to where the quest-giver is located.

When entering Freeside after buying 11 tips, Rotface will now be wearing Eulogy Jones' hat. Due to the way his script is set up, this can only happen upon purchasing exactly 11 tips; if any more tips are bought, the script to give him the hat will not trigger. As such, the most reliable way to get him the hat is to pay for exactly 11 tips, then wait outside the east gate in the Mojave Wasteland, then re-enter Freeside, whereupon he should be wearing the new hat. The hat, which appears to be an expensive cowboy hat with a purple feather, can be obtained by killing or reverse-pickpocketing Rotface - killing Rotface does not cause a drop in Karma, nor will it cause Freeside infamy or hostility from the local residents.

In cut content, this quest had various potential outcomes. The Courier had the option to tell Rotface that his hat looked nice; the next time they returned, Rotface would be wearing Eulogy Jones' suit, and would ask the Courier's opinion on his investment. Based on the response, Rotface would have different reactions the next time he was talked to; he would either buy a .357 Magnum revolver and attempt to mug the Courier, leave Freeside to seek his fortune, join the Followers, or be murdered by a Freeside thug for his newfound wealth.

rules.note: Hat script only triggers on exactly 11

Hand the spare medical supplies over to Joe Cobb.
Let Joe Cobb know once you're ready to take over Goodsprings.
Defeat the Goodsprings militia.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Run Goodsprings Run

Help the Powder Gangers take over Goodsprings.

Reward: Powder Gangers fame; Goodsprings infamy

notes: If Cobb dies in the attack on Goodsprings, but the attack is successful, then the quest will end once all hostile Goodsprings inhabitants have been killed. No further reward is obtainable since he is dead.

If the player character has already spoken to Ringo and agreed to help him during Ghost Town Gunfight, Joe Cobb will dismiss them when they ask to help him take over the town. Each time he is asked, he will claim he does not like the look of the player character.
Once this quest is completed, the surviving Goodsprings citizens will sometimes say, "That was a hell of a way to repay Doc, if you ask me." when interacted with.
Chet does not take part in the fight and will remain alive and act as a merchant in the general store after the quest is completed.

Both Ringo and Joe Cobb will talk about Ringo's safety hideout, saying that Ringo could shoot Joe Cobb through the windows. However, the windows on the outside of the gas station are boarded up, and there are no windows in the interior of the gas station, through which Ringo could shoot or see anyone coming.

Agree to help Lt. Boyd deal with the captured centurion Silus; (Good-Natured Rascal NCR reputation check).
Interrogate Silus
Help Silus escape; (Good-Natured Rascal Legion reputation check)
Choose each [Attack] option to beat Silus until he yields or; pass multiple 50 Speech / 8 Intelligence checks to manipulate him into confessing.
Attack Silus until he yields, then retrieve the silenced .22 pistol from the nearby locker and give it to Silus.

Reward: 250 XP

notes: If Boone is an active companion, killing Silus during this quest will earn 1 of 5 required "history" points towards triggering his companion quest I Forgot to Remember to Forget.
Although Silus will become hostile to the Courier if attacked, he will never actually fight back, only block and sidestep when they hit him.
Caesar will have unique dialogue both if the Courier helped Silus escape or if they killed him.

Regardless of whether the player character chooses to kill Silus during or after the interrogation, all further conversation with Boyd will begin with "Haven't you done enough?" However, this does not have an effect on any other dialogue chains, including quest related dialogue.
Silus disappears from Camp McCarran once he reaches the terminal doors.

If one approaches Lt. Boyd dressed as a member of the NCR, she will address them as an NCR soldier. The dialogue for this side quest changes and she will disregard the player character's offer to help. (This is easily fixed by merely taking off the armor and talking to her again.)

After everything is done, Silus and Boyd will still continue their banter while she is walking away. They will talk to each other as if they are still in the same room despite Boyd being halfway across the building.

On PC, if, for any reason, the Courier is unable to initiate the quest through dialogue with Boyd (or simply wishes to bypass the reputation check), the door can be unlocked via console commands, which will force the quest to proceed as normal and can be finished for either faction.
At the end of the conversation one can choose the attack option, asking if he has any last words, to which he replies "Cedo Nulli" which means "I yield to no one," though he does not become hostile.

Idolized will become Wild Child, while Liked will become Soft-Hearted Devil). However, it will not turn that faction hostile towards the player character, even if their reputation drops to a rank (i.e. Soft-Hearted Devil) which would normally trigger hostility. This can lead to the bizarre situation of Legion assassins or NCR hit-squads tracking them into the wastes, running up to the Courier as if to attack, then simply standing around or running away again. However, if they subsequently return, they may turn hostile.

If one completes the quest by launching the missiles at Caesar's Legion before confronting Benny during Ring-a-Ding-Ding!, their Legion infamy will be removed after speaking to Vulpes Inculta or Alerio and receiving the Mark of Caesar, meaning the player character can still secure a positive reputation with the Legion after targeting them. Similarly, if one launched the missiles at the NCR before receiving Ambassador Crocker's note to start the NCR quest Things That Go Boom, their NCR infamy will be removed after speaking to Crocker and agreeing to help him, meaning the player character can still secure a positive reputation with the NCR after targeting them.

Although both quests of The Apocalypse and The End have the same perk rewards (apart from different fame/infamy gains), completing the former also garners access to the exclusive areas of the Long 15 and/or Dry Wells, and their subsequent high-value loot; as a result, choosing the option to launch the missiles at both factions serves to yield the most potential rewards and loot.

If the player character kills Dermot and Saint James, they can talk to Pretty Sarah and show her the evidence in the journal. She will react with disgust and gift them 4 Med-X. If the player character shows the ledger to her before killing the pair, she will not give anything.
After killing the pair, Westsiders on the road will immediately add a random comment "We still have it better than those two slavers." to their usual banter.

Killing the pair before asking them about the disappearances results in failing the quest. However after asking them, they can be killed without gathering evidence from their rooms. Then the player can report back to Parker and tell him that they found evidence despite not gathering any. Despite this, this will not count as a lie.

name: The Divide

stages.description: Activate the Ashton Missile Silo lift and head for the Divide.
Survive the elevator ride to Ashton Missile Silo.
Make your way to the roof of the collapsed office building and reach the Divide.
Traverse the Divide.
Use the caves to bypass the collapsed building.
Travel to Ulysses' Temple.

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: The Divide
Board the lift to reach the Ashton missile silo;; survive against several waves of tunnelers during the ride.
Navigate through the silo to reach the rooftop of Sunstone Tower.
Navigate the surrounding ravine and detonate a warhead to reveal the entrance to the Cave of the Abaddon.
Survive against the tunneler nest and reach the heart of the Divide.
Navigate the surrounding area to reach the entrance to Ulysses' Temple.
Reward: 4400 XP
Leads to: The Tunnelers

notes: The "fake" Ulysses (separate Form ID from the main one) appears again during this quest, in an inaccessible alcove across from the slanted metal column used to descend from the Sunstone Tower rooftop.
During the dialogue with Ulysses-via-EDE on the Sunstone Tower roof, choosing the following options as they come up will trigger completion flags for advancing the Most Likely To... challenge:
"You said I brought it from the West?"
"Why would I have brought it here?"
"You said you made a promise not to kill me. Why?"
"What's our history? How do you know me?"

name: The End
reward_text: 5000 XP; Divide Survivor perk * 1 additional SPECIAL point * Brotherhood of Steel and Followers of the Apocalypse fame Stored in a footlocker near the canyon wreckage: * 3 bitter drink + bitter drink recipe * Courier duster (faction-dependent) * Old Glory * Red Glare * 100 rockets * 2 snakebite tourniquets * Ulysses' duster * Ulysses' final message * Ulysses' mask

stages.description: Cancel the missile launch.
Run for the Canyon Wreckage.
Optional: Deliver Ulysses' final message.

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: The End
Reach the control console within the central launch chamber of Ulysses' Temple.
Have ED-E hack the controls and abort the launch.
Set the missile to launch at the territory of NCR/Legion/both factions.
Leads to: The Apocalypse
Escape the Temple to return to the Mojave Wasteland.

Reward: 5000 XP; Divide Survivor perk: 1 additional SPECIAL point + Brotherhood of Steel and Followers of the Apocalypse fame; Stored in a footlocker near the canyon wreckage: 3 bitter drink + Courier duster (faction-dependent) + Old Glory + Red Glare + 100 rockets + 2 snakebite tourniquets + Ulysses' duster + Ulysses' final message holotape + Ulysses' mask

notes: Prior to the release of the Lonesome Road add-on (and still so without the add-on installed or by completing The Apocalypse), it was impossible in normal gameplay to acquire enough fame with the Brotherhood of Steel to achieve an Idolized reputation due to a lack of sufficient fruitful methods of raising reputation with them. Completing this quest to stop the Divide missile launch, alongside all other Brotherhood quests in the base game, now makes it possible to become Idolized with the Brotherhood.

If the player character has a reputation that does not allow Veronica to become a companion, the reputation increase with the Brotherhood of Steel will be substantial enough to allow them to have Veronica as a follower if one chooses to recruit her after the conclusion of Lonesome Road.

rules.when: completed with the other Brotherhood quests
rules.note: Makes Idolized reputation possible; can enable Veronica as a follower

name: The Finger of Suspicion
reward_text: 100 XP; Legion fame

stages.description: Find Martina Groesbeck
Eliminate the Omerta thugs sent to kill Martina.
Return to Vulpes and let him know Martina's safe.
Return to Vulpes and let him know Martina's dead.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: The Finger of Suspicion
Speak with Vulpes Inculta in Caesar's tent at the Fort;; ask about doing more work for the Legion.
Reach Vault 21 on the Strip and deal with the Omerta thugs threatening Martina Groesbeck.
Incite the Omerta thugs to attack and kill them.
Pass a 50 Speech skill check to convince them to leave.

Speak with Martina.
Return to Vulpes.

notes: If the Speech check is used to pacify the thugs, one will receive an additional 100 XP for a total of 200 XP upon quest completion when returning to Vulpes (even if the thugs were killed after passing the Speech check).
At the start of the quest, one can ask for a reward, which Vulpes will promise to give. Regardless of how the quest was completed, there will be no monetary reward, and only garnering Legion fame.

stages.description: Optional: Speak to Waking Cloud about taking her as a guide.
Find a way to unlock the door to the Survivalist's cache.
Find a map of the Grand Staircase region.

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: The Grand Staircase
Reach Morning Glory Cave west of the North Fork Bridge.
Locate and obtain the Grand Staircase map holotape from the survival cache in the main campsite.
Reward: Variable XP; Assorted survival cache loot
Leads to: Gathering Storms

name: The House Always Wins I
reward_text: 1000-1250 caps; Lucky 38 presidential suite as player character housing; 600 XP (part 1)

stages.description: Talk to Mr. House at the Lucky 38.
Bring the Platinum Chip to Mr. House.
Go to the basement of the Lucky 38.
Observe as Mr. House upgrades Securitrons.
Return to Mr. House.

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: The House Always Wins I
Enter the Lucky 38 on the Strip.
Speak to Mr. House in the penthouse.
Speak to Swank at the reception desk inside the Tops Casino.
Pass a series of Speech checks/present pieces of evidence to convince Swank to let you search Benny's room for evidence.
Confront Benny on the Casino floor.
Search his room for evidence.
Kill Benny.
Seduce Benny with the Black Widow perk to get him alone.
Go to the presidential suite with or without Benny.
Talk to Yes Man and learn about the platinum chip.
Kill Benny in his sleep or leave him alone.
Survive the ambush.
Take the platinum chip after killing Benny. If he escaped, find him at the Fort.
Return to Mr. House and watch his demonstration of the Securitron Mk II OS.
Reward: 1000-1250 caps; Lucky 38 presidential suite as player character housing; 600-750 XP; Achievement / Trophy
Leads to: The House Always Wins II

notes: The first time one enters the Lucky 38, any companions must wait outside. If the player character enters without telling them to wait, they will automatically be made to wait on the steps outside the casino doors and one must manually prompt them to follow again upon exiting.

Mr. House has unique dialogue if one visits him for the first time after entering the Tops and either killing Benny or letting him escape to the Fort. He also has unique dialogue if one visits him for the first time after completing The House Always Wins II and activating the Securitron vault beneath the Fort.

name: The House Always Wins II
reward_text: 500 XP

stages.description: Use the Platinum Chip to open the secret bunker at Fortification Hill.
Enter the secret bunker.
Upgrade Mr.House's secret Securitron army.
(Optional) Change your mind and upgrade Mr. House's secret Securitron army.
Report back to Mr. House for further instructions.

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: The House Always Wins II
Reach the Fort via Cottonwood Cove.
Retrieve the platinum chip from Caesar.
Enter the weather monitoring station on Caesar's orders, avoiding conflict.
Fight your way to the weather monitoring station.
Destroy the Securitron vault's generators for Caesar.
Use the platinum chip to upgrade the Securitron army.
Reward: Quest failure.
Return to Mr. House in the Lucky 38.
Reward: Quest complete
Leads to: The House Always Wins III

notes: After completing this quest, Victor will disappear from the Lucky 38 casino floor, allowing one to directly choose where to travel in the Lucky 38.

Mr. House (in the Securitron vault) has unique dialogue if one enters the vault before visiting him for the first time in the Lucky 38 penthouse and after entering the Tops and either killing Benny or letting him escape to the Fort.

If one destroys the Securitron vault, but before returning to the Lucky 38 afterward, generic NPCs in the Mojave will comment that Mr. House has publicly agreed to turn over ownership of the Strip to the NCR by the following year. This appears to relate to cut content where House would've ceded New Vegas over to the NCR and received NCR citizenship.

rules.note: Also fails The House Always Wins; same for Render Unto Caesar and Wild Card: You and What Army?

Kill the Boomers' leaders, Pearl and Loyal to neutralize the tribe.

Reward: The restored B-29 will appear during the Second Battle of Hoover Dam.
Talk to Mr. House in the Lucky 38.
Reward: Quest complete; Don't Tread on the Bear!, Beware the Wrath of Caesar! permanently failed.

reward_text: None

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: The House Always Wins IV

Kill the Omertas and remove them as a threat.
Complete How Little We Know to ensure the Omertas' continued loyalty.
Return to Mr. House in the Lucky 38.

(Optional) Inform Mr. House that you've negotiated a peaceful solution with the Brotherhood.
Inform Mr. House that the Brotherhood's bunker has been destroyed.

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: The House Always Wins V
Gain access to the Hidden Valley bunker.
Bring Veronica as an active companion.
Deal with Ranger Dobson during Still in the Dark.
Attack and kill all Brotherhood members in the bunker.
Activate the bunker's self-destruct protocol.
Optional: Hack a Hard-locked terminal to turn the bunker's automated turrets against the Brotherhood.
Return to Mr. House in the Lucky 38.
Leads to: The House Always Wins VI

reward_text: None

stages.description: Go to Hoover Dam and Protect President Kimball during his visit.
Inform Mr. House that President Kimball's visit was cancelled.
Inform Mr. House that President Kimball survived the assassination attempt.
Inform Mr. House that President Kimball is dead.

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: The House Always Wins VI
Gain a neutral or negative reputation with the NCR.
Protect President Kimball at Hoover Dam during You'll Know It When It Happens.
Reward: Quest failure
Reward: Quest complete
Leads to: The House Always Wins VII

notes: Killing Ranger Grant instantly before President Kimball's arrival or leaving the Hoover Dam area after preparing for the speech during You'll Know It When It Happens will automatically result in failing the quest and Kimball being assassinated.

Attacking Grant or any NCR personnel in his presence prior to Kimball arriving will result in the speech being canceled, but Mr. House will give the same response as if the player character successfully protected Kimball.

If Kimball is assassinated by the Legion or the player character kills him during his visit as part of You'll Know It When It Happens, this quest will fail upon returning to Mr. House. He will be furious at what has happened and says that he will be forced to gamble on the outcome but will not turn hostile and allow Part VII to start.

If one removes the Vertibird bomb but then attacks Kimball and lets him escape, returning to Mr. House will result in the quest failing and him asking why the player character attacked Kimball. Regardless of the response, he still gives Part VII as above.

rules.when: Kimball assassinated, or Grant killed, or leaving after preparing the speech

reward_text: None

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: The House Always Wins VIII
Prepare for battle and talk to Mr. House in the Lucky 38.

reward_text: NCR or Legion fame

stages.description: Mr. House is dead. His grand dreams for New Vegas will never be realized.
You have irrevocably disconnected Mr. House from the Lucky 38's mainframe computers.

name: The Job
reward_text: 2310 XP; Red Glare (2) (optional)

stages.description: Find the Laser detonator.
Use the Laser detonator on the warhead.
Make your way through the Lonesome Road to the collapsed overpass tunnel.
Escape the Tunnelers' cave and reach the High Road.

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: The Job
Complete The Silo by exiting the missile silo bunker and entering the Hopeville Missile Base;; speak with Ulysses through ED-E.
Reach the marked men base near the base headquarters and obtain the laser detonator;; use the detonator to destroy the warhead obstructing the path back into the base.
Clear the barrier of car wrecks blocking the way out of the missile base by detonating another warhead.
Navigate through the collapsed overpass tunnel to reach the entrance to the High Road.
Reward: 2310 XP; Red Glare (2) (optional)
Leads to: The Launch

name: The Launch
reward_text: 4400 XP; Access to the Courier's Mile; Condemned to Repeat It achievement/trophy

stages.description: Reach Ashton Silo Central Station at the end of the High Road.
Activate the console to gain access to Ashton Missile Silo.

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: The Launch
Fight across the length of the High Road from northwest to southeast.
Reach the Ashton silo control station.
Activate the control console and launch the nuclear missile to open the sealed silo.
Reward: 4400 XP; Access to the Courier's Mile; Condemned to Repeat It achievement/trophy
Leads to: The Divide

notes: Ulysses appears in a small vantage point on the right-hand side of the toppled-over skyscraper serving as the Crow's Nest when leaving Beast's camp near the High Road entrance for the first time, disappearing shortly after. He is indicated by a non-hostile radar marker and cannot be damaged if shot from afar.
This Ulysses is actually separate from the one who appears later, having a separate ref ID and the editor ID NVDLC04UlyssesFake.

Like in the previous quest, Ulysses' opening dialogue upon reaching the High Road entrance will differ depending on which (or none) of the player character's reputations with the three major factions in Fallout: New Vegas is the highest at that point, as follows:

name: The Legend of the Star
reward_text: Unlocks next quest

stages.description: Find the Sunset Sarsaparilla Headquarters and speak to Festus.
Return to Festus with enough Sunset Sarsaparilla Star Caps to earn a prize!
Head to the Sunset Sarsaparilla prize closet to receive your real prize.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: The Legend of the Star
Reach the Sunset Sarsaparilla headquarters and speak with Festus.
Find 50 Sunset Sarsaparilla star bottle caps.
Return to Festus and deposit the star bottle caps.
Reward: Achievement/trophy
Leads to: A Valuable Lesson

notes: While the quest is formally triggered by talking to Festus in the HQ, one can still collect star bottle caps towards the required 50 beforehand, even reaching/surpassing that amount by the time one gets to the HQ.

Festus mentions in the "Legend of the Star" story that before Sunset Sarsaparilla was invented, the main choices people had for soft drinks were water or Nuka-Cola. This contradicts the information on the logo for the Sunset Sarsaparilla Company, which states that it was founded in 1918, 126 years before the foundation of the Nuka-Cola Corporation in 2044.
Star bottle caps can still be collected after bringing the required 50 to Festus during the quest. However, any additional star bottle caps will automatically be added as regular bottle caps.
Deactivating Festus with the Robotics Expert perk will render this quest permanently impossible to complete.

The achievement/trophy icon for this quest is similar to the icon for Sierra Madre Souvenir Aficionado in the Dead Money add-on. The differences include the Vault Boy holding red bottle caps rather than Sierra Madre chips and having blue star eyes instead of love hearts.

rules.note: Permanent

name: The Moon Comes Over the Tower
source: The Moon Comes Over the Tower
reward_text: 500 XP; Followers fame; (Optional) 2 doctor's bags, 2 Med-X, 2 Jet, 5 stimpaks, 2 super stimpaks, 2 copies of Today's Physician

stages.description: Bug an access point to the Lucky 38's data network for the Followers of the Apocalypse.
Disable the Lucky 38's network encryption from three executive consoles.
Return to Emily Ortal on the New Vegas strip with news that the tower has been bugged.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: The Moon Comes Over the Tower

Speak with Emily Ortal on the Strip after exiting the Lucky 38 during The House Always Wins I;; agree to help her bug Mr. House's network;; pass a 6 Intelligence attribute check to learn more about her motives.
(Optional) Pass a 40 Barter skill check to persuade Emily to gift medical supplies.
Access the terminal behind the VIP lounge's bar in the Lucky 38 casino to plant the bug.
Return to Emily.
Reward: 500 XP; Followers fame; (Optional) 2 doctor's bags, 2 Med-X, 2 Jet, 5 stimpaks, 2 super stimpaks, 2 copies of Today's Physician

notes: Mr. House will have unique dialogue if one speaks to him during this quest to inform him about the bug, whether that they intend to plant it in his network, or that they already did.

After returning to Emily to talk about the bug, passing a 35 Speech check will convince her to talk about some of her other exploits including helping Benny work on a Securitron he wanted reprogrammed, creating Yes Man, in order to link it to Mr. House's data network while remaining invisible to his security since, in the event that Mr. House detects a rogue device on his network, he remotely fries it. She also states that the bug she uses during the quest is her second attempt to extract data from the network.

This quest can be started even if Mr. House is dead/neutralized and The House Has Gone Bust! failed, and will end exactly the same way. However, the quest will fail if Mr. House is killed after starting it. Simply disabling Mr. House won't fail the quest, and the bug will still be found and disconnected.
Passing the Barter check with Emily during this quest is one of the few times that the player character's name (chosen in character creation) is mentioned in dialogue.

If Arcade Gannon is an active companion, he will sarcastically react to the fact that Emily does not acknowledge him at all, even though he was present and both of them being Followers. Upon entering the Lucky 38 after speaking with Emily, Arcade will pretend to greet Emily as a fellow member of the Followers and mockingly agree to help infiltrate the Lucky 38.

A "" option can be found on three terminals across the Mojave Wasteland and was originally designed to be part of this quest. A quest stage (still in GECK) would have required the player character to perform the override on all three terminals in order to unlock the terminal in the Lucky 38 to be bugged. In the final game, this stage is skipped entirely, and the player character can just talk to Emily and continue after placing the bug via a message prompt. There are three terminals with this option:
Anthony House's office at the H&H Tools factory.
House Resort at Camp Golf, on a terminal in the room to the right of Chief Hanlon's office.
New Vegas Steel, in the first room.

rules.target: The Moon Comes Over the Tower
rules.when: Mr. House killed after starting it
rules.note: Disabling House does not fail it

name: The Reunion
reward_text: 10 XP

stages.description: Travel to the Canyon Wreckage near Primm and enter the Divide.

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: The Reunion
Complete Ain't That a Kick in the Head and leave Doc Mitchell's house in Goodsprings.
Reach the canyon wreckage slightly northwest of the California Sunset Drive-in near Primm, then interact with it to enter the Divide.
Reward: 10 XP
Leads to: The Silo

name: The Screams of Brahmin
reward_text: 75 caps; 10 brahmin steaks (from the McBride house fridge); Novac fame

walkthrough.text: Unmarked quest: The Screams of Brahmin
Reach Novac and speak with either Jeannie May Crawford or No-bark Noonan;; ask about ongoing events around the town.
Speak with Dusty McBride at his ranch;; agree to find out the cause of his brahmin dying.
Locate and kill the stealthy nightkin near the McBride ranch, then recover the holotape on its body;; (optional) wait until around midnight for it to appear.
Return to Dusty.
Reward: 75 caps; 10 brahmin steaks (from the McBridge house fridge); Novac fame

notes: At higher levels, the attacker may instead be a stronger nightkin master.
If Dusty McBride is killed before completing the quest, the nightkin can still be killed, but no cap or karma reward can be obtained.
If one remains undetected close to the nightkin without attacking, he will occasionally make unique comments including ones that vary depending on the player character's current active companion.
"Horns will help the bull. Voices say they knew that would happen." (Great Khans and Caesar's Legion)
"Bears in pain. Head voices not surprised." (NCR)
"Ha ha. Funny robot make blinky sounds." (ED-E)
"Head voices say smart man also metal man. Don't like metal men." (Arcade Gannon)
"Book girl has hard decision to make." (Veronica Santangelo)
"Head voices say quiet man knows more than he says about horns." (Craig Boone)
"Head voices say they knew flower girl's father." (Rose of Sharon Cassidy)
"Head voices know smelly ghoul. He old and good with guns." (Raul Tejada)
"Head voices speak of doggy with squishy brain." (Rex)
"Head voices say someone close. Someone like us." (Lily Bowen)

name: The Silo
reward_text: 2200 XP; Duplicated ED-E as a companion

stages.description: Navigate Hopeville Missile Silo to reach the Lonesome Road.
Find something to break the encryption on the blast door terminal.
Optional: Have ED-E access the Commissary for you.
Use ED-E to break the encryption on the blast door terminal.
Turn the silo's power back on.
Find the security codes for the missile silo network.
Use ED-E to unlock the mainframe.
Activate the mainframe to unlock the silo's exterior doors.

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: The Silo
Enter the Hopeville missile silo bunker from the pass to canyon wreckage in the Divide.
Find and re-activate the eyebot duplicate of ED-E to operate the bunker systems.
Navigate through and reach the bunker's exit into the Hopeville Missile Base.
Reward: 2200 XP; Duplicated ED-E as a companion
Leads to: The Job

name: The Star Showdown
reward_text: 2-9 Sunset Sarsaparilla star bottle caps (player-dependent); Various loot from one or both NPCs

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: The Star Showdown
Obtain at least one Sunset Sarsaparilla star bottle cap, then travel to Nipton going east from the Nipton Road pit stop.;; witness the gunfight between Tomas and Jacklyn or intervene.
Speak with the survivor about the attack and its cause.
Tomas lives
Jacklyn lives
Leave him alone or; demand his "lucky star" necklace or; pass a 40 Speech skill check to receive it peacefully.
Leave her alone or; comment on her collecting star bottle caps or; pass a 7 Intelligence check to callout her theft of the caps from Tomas.
Reward: 2-9 Sunset Sarsaparilla star bottle caps (player-dependent); Various loot from one or both NPCs

notes: If the player character does not actually pass the area in which they have the gunfight, they may be randomly approached by either of them later in the game.
If the fight is missed, he will normally walk to the Courier and if his bottle caps were not taken by the Courier, one can find him at the place where the gunfight was.
Tomas and Jacklyn have a special faction tag that causes random critters and raiders to ignore them, to prevent randomly spawned mobs from interrupting their gunfight.
Tomas and Jacklyn both have relatively high HP (120 each) and a severely low Guns skill level (5 each), so their shootout may last a significant period of time until one dies if left alone.

After speaking with the Courier (if they do not become hostile), the survivor of the gunfight will travel to the Mojave Outpost and disappear from the game world, taking their amount of star bottle caps with them.

If the Courier has gained the Terrifying Presence perk, it is possible to get as many as 16 Sunset Sarsaparilla star bottle caps from this encounter. To accomplish this, Jacklyn must win the fight, and the ensuing conversation must be ended without provoking her to attack or betray the Courier. Jacklyn's 9 star bottle caps can then be pickpocketed off of her as she walks away. Then take Tomas's journal from his body to prove her a liar. Reinitiate conversation after doing so, accuse her of stealing, and then demand the necklace with the Terrifying Presence option. She will hand over seven additional bottle caps before walking back to the Mojave Outpost and disappearing.

name: The Treacherous Road
reward_text: Variable XP

stages.description: Deal with the White Leg traps.
Optional: Disarm the traps on the bridge.
Optional: Kill the White Legs planting the traps.

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: The Treacherous Road
Reach the Old Rockville Bridge northeast of the Spine and east of Two Skies Cave.
Disarm the bear traps along the bridge.
Locate and kill the marked White Legs sappers to the northeast.
Reward: Variable XP
Leads to: Gathering Storms

notes: Though they are marked on the compass, the bear traps may be hard to spot against the brown coloring of the ground and bridge, especially at night. The Pip-Boy light can be useful but also may draw attention from any nearby White Legs or creatures.

There can be yao guai and several varieties of gecko in addition to the White Legs that spawn around the bridge. After killing enemies on the bridge, it is possible that their corpses may lie on top of a trap, making it impossible to spot without first moving the bodies.

It is possible to complete both optional parts of the quest, but it requires good timing. While killing the last of the White Legs, the final bear trap can be quickly disarmed. However, this will not result in any extra rewards.

It is possible when entering the area that the quest will suddenly complete without actually doing anything. This is due to the White Legs either being killed by the various creatures around the bridge or simply walking into their own traps.

reward_text: 2200 XP; Duplicate ED-E temporarily leaves as a companion

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: The Tunnelers
Navigate through the Cave of the Abaddon to reach the exterior of Ulysses' Temple
Reward: 2200 XP; Duplicate ED-E temporarily lost as a companion
Leads to: The Courier

reward_text: Key to the MP confiscated goods trunk; 650 XP; Access to the MP confiscated goods trunkAnderson remains free:; Followers fameAnderson turned in, secret kept:; Karma gainAnderson's confession turned in:; NCR fame; 10 maize, 10 banana yucca fruit and 10 coyote tobacco chew from Trent BascomWestside Co-op agreement:; 250-400 caps every 24 in-game hours from Clayton Ettienne

stages.description: (Optional) Look through Corporal White's personal effects in his locker in the McCarran Concourse area.

Find out what Trent Bascom knows about Corporal White.

Ask Tom Anderson about Corporal White's whereabouts.

Confront Anderson about Corporal White's disappearance.
Kill Anderson.
Speak with Etienne to complete your "Business" arrangement with Anderson.
Tell Lieutenant Boyd what happened to Corporal White.

Reach Camp McCarran and speak with Col. Hsu and Cpt. Curtis during I Put a Spell on You, and then Lt. Boyd;; ask about the missing base personnel.
(Optional) Acquire Corporal White's journal from his locker in the concourse.

Pass a 6 Intelligence attribute check or; Smiling Troublemaker Followers reputation check to convince Anderson to reveal the truth behind White's disappearance.

Agree to keep Westside's secret in exchange for a 10% cut of profits from the Westside Co-op (20% with 50 Barter).
Turn Anderson in (turns him hostile) and then take Anderson's confession from the body to give to Boyd.
Agree to keep Westside's secret and lie about White's disappearance.
Convince Anderson to turn himself in, in exchange for keeping Westside's secret.
Return to Lt. Boyd.

Reward: 650 XP; Access to the MP confiscated goods trunk; Anderson remains free: Followers fame; Anderson turned in, secret kept: Karma gain; Anderson's confession turned in: NCR fame, 10 maize, 10 banana yucca fruit and 10 coyote tobacco chew from Trent Bascom; Westside Co-op agreement: 250-400 caps every 24 in-game hours from Clayton Ettienne

notes: The dialogue path with Lt. Boyd about Anderson asking to increase water flow to Freeside and taking it to Colonel Hsu, that may get someone else to stumble into the water numbers discrepancy, has no noticeable effects in the game.

This quest originally involved a step that required the player character to speak to a cut character named Wrench to learn more about the water shortage. The character and his quest stage were removed for unknown reasons.

Westside thugs were meant to harass the player character after they confronted Hector in the north cistern but were eventually cut from the quest. The thugs are still in the game's files, alongside their dialogue for accosting the PC and potentially attacking them based on player choice.

name: There Stands the Grass
reward_text: 1200-2200 XP; 1200-2600 caps (varies with skill checks)

stages.description: Enter Vault 22 and download the research data found there.
Return to Dr. Hildern at Camp McCarran with the research data.
(Optional) Find Keely, a researcher who has gone missing at Vault 22.
Meet Keely at her base of operations on the second level.
Find the vents Keely is pumping gas through and somehow ignite the gas.
Return to Keely and let her know the spores have been purged.
Return to Camp McCarran and tell Dr. Williams that Keely is safe.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: There Stands the Grass
Reach Camp McCarran and speak with Doctor Thomas Hildern in the terminal building;; agree to help OSI improve their farming technology.

(Optional) Speak with Doctor Angela Williams and agree to find the missing researcher Keely;; speak with Dr. Hildern after and pass a 40 Speech skill check to negotiate increased payment upon completion.
Reach Vault 22 west-northwest of Westside.
Acquire the keycard from the residential quarters on level 4 to access the caves and reach level 5.
Pass a 50 Repair skill check to fix the Vault's elevator connected to all levels.
Locate and interact with the terminal to download the research data on level 5.
(Optional) Search for Keely in the caves connected to level 5.
(Optional) Agree to meet with Keely at her lab on level 2 to deal with the infestation in the Vault.
(Optional) Use fire, explosives, or lasers to ignite the gas vent on level 5 and destroy the fungal spores.
(Optional) Return to Keely.
(Optional) Agree to let Keely erase the research data.

(Optional) Refuse to erase the research data (turns Keely hostile) or; start and progress I Could Make You Care up to acquiring the data with Veronica, then convince Keely to let the Brotherhood take possession of it.
Return to Camp McCarran to inform Dr. Williams that Keely is safe/dead;; pass a 50 Speech check to convince her to give payment if Keely died.
Return to Dr. Hildern to give him the data/tell him the data is lost
Reward: 1200-1500 XP; 1200-2600 caps (varies with skill checks)

notes: If this quest is completed before starting I Could Make You Care, one will lose the option to retrieve the Vault 22 data as part of that quest, as there is no option to ask Dr. Hildern to give the data back even if that outcome was chosen.

If one completes There Stands the Grass before ED-E My Love and destroys the research rather than giving it to Hildern, one may not be able to trigger ED-E's audio log, or the dialogue on Hildern with Arcade Gannon. If one wishes to trigger either companion's dialogue, do so before completing There Stands the Grass.
The Vault has several exposed gas pipes, so one must be wary when using a flame-based weapon such as the flamer or Shishkebab.

If the data has been downloaded before receiving this quest, one will be able to give Dr. Hildern the data immediately upon speaking to him. The best way to go would be speaking to Dr. Williams after receiving the quest to be able to look for Keely, speaking to Dr. Hildern, giving him the data, and bartering the additional caps out of him. After that, the quest will be marked as finished. It is still possible, though, to get caps for rescuing Keely by returning to the vault once more. Some things like the quest logs might not trigger correctly. It could also be necessary to pickpocket the passcode from Keely because the door might not open even after helping her. Be sure to return to Dr. Williams afterward to receive the caps.
The act of killing Keely does not result in Karma loss, while lying to Dr. Williams about her safety does.

Keely may not spawn unless the optional quest to find her is accepted from Dr. Williams. Even after downloading the data, one can still go back to Dr. Williams and receive the optional quest, then head back to Vault 22 and rescue Keely.

rules.when: completed before I Could Make You Care

name: They Went That-a-Way
reward_text: 1000 XP; Achievement / Trophy

stages.description: Find the men who tried to kill you.
[Optional] Talk to Victor about your rescue
Inquire about your delivery assignment with the administrator of the Mojave Express in Primm.
Find Primm's lawman to get information on where your attackers went.
Head to Novac through Nipton. Ask around Novac about your attackers.
Find out from Manny Vargas where the Khans were headed.
Intercept the Great Khans at Boulder City.

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: They Went That-a-Way
(Optional) Talk to Victor about your attackers.
Find evidence of the attackers in Primm.
(Optional) Rescue Deputy Beagle from the escaped convicts in the Bison Steve Hotel.
Find evidence of the attackers in Novac by traveling through Nipton.
(Optional) Gain information from Manny Vargas by either completing Come Fly With Me, taking the Confirmed Bachelor perk, or accessing his terminal.
Reach the Great Khans' hideout at Boulder City and talk to Jessup.
Reward: 1000 XP; Achievement/Trophy
Leads to: Ring-a-Ding-Ding!

notes: This quest can be completed at any time by simply going inside the Tops casino and finding Benny there.
If this quest is completed before speaking with Trudy from Goodsprings, it prevents her from displaying a dialogue option which initiates the unmarked quest Trudy's Radio Repair.
If the quest My Kind of Town is completed before talking to Deputy Beagle about Benny, the dialogue option will not be present, although this can be fixed by pickpocketing his journal off him.

Inside the Great Khan hideout in the Boulder City ruins, in a room behind the counter where Jessup is hiding, one can find the body of McMurphy, the mustached Great Khan that was to Benny's right during the intro.

name: Things That Go Boom
reward_text: 200 XP; 300-500 bottle caps; NCR fame

stages.description: Ambassador Crocker has told the Courier about the Boomer quest. But it hasn't been accepted yet.
Convince the Boomers to help the Courier in the upcoming battle.
Return to Ambassador Crocker and let him know of the results of meeting with the Boomers.
Return to Ambassador Crocker and let him know the Boomers will help.
Tell Ambassador Crocker that the Boomers will not help.
Ambassador Crocker found out that the Courier has already pledged the Boomer's support and is disappointed.

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: Things That Go Boom
Speak with Ambassador Dennis Crocker in the NCR Embassy.
Reach the Boomers' territory at Nellis Air Force Base.
Kill the Boomers' leaders, Pearl and Loyal to neutralize the tribe.
Enlist the Boomers' aid by completing Volare!.
Reward: The restored B-29 will appear during the Second Battle of Hoover Dam.
Return to Ambassador Crocker in the NCR Embassy.
Reward: 200 XP; 300-500 bottle caps; NCR fame.
Leads to: Kings' Gambit

notes: Starting this quest will disregard any previous negative reputation with the NCR; even a Courier who is Vilified with the NCR will still be allowed to enter the embassy and talk to Crocker. Additionally, accepting this quest will remove any infamy with the NCR. If one has already met the Boomers beforehand, reporting that they will or will not help will also clear any NCR infamy.
Wiping out the Boomers or completing Volare! beforehand will greatly reduce the time needed to complete the quest.

Despite Crocker asking for the Boomers to help the NCR, all dialogue options with him about the Boomers being recruited indicates that the tribe is actually helping the player character, but Crocker fails to notice and will still allow for completing the quest and progressing the NCR faction arc.
Failing Don't Tread on the Bear! will also fail this quest and permanently lock out the NCR ending.

rules.note: Even Vilified Couriers may enter the embassy

name: Thought for the Day
reward_text: Hints at future events around the Mojave

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: Thought for a Day
Reach the 188 Trading Post and speak with the Forecaster on the lower level across from Alexander's spot
Pay 100 caps, up to a maximum of 300, to listen to each of his "forecasts" on various topics
Reward: Hints at future events around the Mojave

name: Three-Card Bounty
reward_text: 250 caps + 100 XP per bounty; NCR fame; 500 caps + 500 XP (after all three)

stages.description: Major Dhatri has bounties available. Speak to him about receiving a mission or turning in a bounty.
Kill Violet and acquire her head - preferably intact.
Kill Cook-Cook and acquire his head - preferably intact.
(Optional) Kill Cook-Cook's favorite brahmin, Queenie, to cause him to go berserk and attack friends and foes alike.
(Optional) Speak with Little Buster about Cook-Cook.
Kill Driver Nephi and acquire his head - preferably intact.
[Optional] Enlist the help of Lieutenant Gorobets and his First Recon snipers to take down Driver Nephi.
Return to Major Dhatri with Violet's head and collect the bounty.
Return to Major Dhatri wtih Cook-Cook's head and collect the bounty.
Return to Major Dhatri with Driver Nephi's head and collect the bounty.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Three-Card Bounty
Speak to Maj. Dhatri at Camp McCarran;; ask about the Fiends and problems with them.
Select the bounty for Violet.
Select the bounty for Cook-Cook.
Select the bounty for Driver Nephi.
(Optional) Speak with Little Buster to learn about Cook-Cook's pet brahmin, Queenie.
(Optional) Speak with Lt. Gorobets to have First Recon as support.
Reach the trailer compound near the Poseidon gas station.
Reach Cook-Cook's camp near the South Vegas ruins west entrance.
Reach Driver Nephi's camp northwest of the Samson rock crushing plant.
Kill Violet and acquire Violet's head/Violet's mangled head.
Kill Cook-Cook and collect Cook-Cook's head/Cook-Cook's mangled head.
Kill Driver Nephi and collect Driver Nephi's head/Driver Nephi's mangled head.
First Recon will relocate from Camp McCarran to Camp Forlorn Hope.
Bring the collected head(s) as proof of the bounty to Maj. Dhatri.
Reward: 250 caps + 100 XP per bounty; NCR fame; 500 caps + 500 XP (after all three)

notes: If one takes the Bloody Mess perk, its secondary effect might prevent the player character from getting an intact head and thus not get the full bounty during this quest, since the perk increases the chance of an enemy kill resulting in dismemberment including destroying the head. One can circumvent this by having a companion be the one to deal the killing shot/blow. However, companions still have a chance of damaging the bounty's head.
Even if one chooses a specific bounty, it is still possible to find and kill any of the other two bounty targets and turn in their heads to Dhatri, even without having their quest objectives active.

However, in the case of killing Driver Nephi without having selected his bounty, this can lock out the additional reward from Lt. Gorobets, as the option to recruit his squad is only unlocked if the quest objective is active.
If Alpha Team was recruited to help in killing Driver Nephi, each member except for Gorobets will have unique one-time comments depending on whether or not they were able to hit Nephi at least once:
Alpha Team will relocate to Camp Forlorn Hope (when applicable) immediately after turning in Driver Nephi's head to Major Dhatri.

If Driver Nephi is killed before speaking to Major Dhatri about the bounty and without looting his head, Lieutenant Gorobets will be aware that Driver was killed by the player character (he behaves as if the bounty had been completed and the head turned in). The same is true for Cook-Cook and Little Buster.

After completing this quest, Little Buster will disappear from Camp McCarran the next time the cell resets (generally three in-game days after the last time the player character visited it). He will then be found dead in Freeside, on the train tracks near the Old Mormon Fort.

rules.when: Driver Nephi killed without selecting his bounty

name: Tourist Traipse
reward_text: Lore information about Vault 21

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: Tourist Traipse
Reach Vault 21 on the Strip and speak with Sarah Weintraub in the gift shop;; ask about her hotel business
Agree to follow along on her Vault 21 tour.
Reward: Lore information about Vault 21

name: Tourist Trap
reward_text: Variable XP

stages.description: Search the Zion Ranger station for a medical supply kit.
Find turpentine for the medical supply kit.
Find duct tape for the medical supply kit.
Salvage the medical supply kit at a campfire.
Optional: Find whiskey, vodka, or scotch to sterilize the medical supply kit.
Search the Zion General Store for five Li'l Scout lunchboxes.
Find the key to the desk in the Zion General Store.

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: Tourist Trap
Reach the General Store and Ranger station west of Cueva Guarache.
Obtain five Li'l Scout lunchboxes within the General Store.
Locate a medical supply kit within the Ranger station.
Use spare parts of duct tape and turpentine to substitute the contaminated supplies.
Use alcohol such as scotch, vodka, or whiskey to sterilize the contaminated supplies.
Pass a Medicine 30 skill check to salvage the supply kit.
Reward: Variable XP
Leads to: Deliverer of Sorrows

name: Trigger the Gala Event
reward_text: 1600 XP; Vending machine codes: Super stimpak, Holorifle focus optics (optional)

stages.description: Get to the Gala Event control panel at the top of the bell tower in Salida del Sol North and activate it.
Get to the Sierra Madre main gate and enter the casino.

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: Trigger the Gala Event
After completing the three previous quests, go to Campanas del Sol in the northernmost section of Salida del Sol North.
Reach the steeple of the bell tower and use the controls to trigger the Gala Event.
Escape Campanas del Sol and return to the Villa fountain and the gate to the Sierra Madre Casino & Resort.
Reward: 1600 XP; Vending machine codes: Super stimpak, Holorifle focus optics (optional)
Leads to: Put the Beast Down

name: Trudy's Radio Repair
reward_text: Goodsprings fame; 50 - 75 caps; 10 - 35 XP

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: Trudy's Radio Repair
Reach Goodsprings and speak with Trudy in the Prospector Saloon;; ask about her previous visitors during They Went That-a-Way.
Pass a 20 Repair check to fix the broken radio on the shelf behind Trudy's bar.
Return to Trudy;; pass a 20 Barter skill check to negotiate the caps reward from 50 to 75.
Reward: Goodsprings fame; 50 - 75 caps; 10 - 35 XP

notes: Despite Trudy mentioning her desire to hear Mr. New Vegas's voice again, when fixed, the radio is actually set to Mojave Music Radio without the DJ's narration.
Upon fixing the radio, Trudy will mention she was able to hear it functioning again even if she is outside the saloon at the time.

name: Unfriendly Persuasion
reward_text: Do not ask Marcus for money, do not kill the mercenaries:; 350 XPGet more money from Marcus:; 250 XP; 2,000/2,500 caps; OR; Karma loss; 3,000 capsKill the mercenaries:; 250 XP; NCR infamy

stages.description: Speak with the leader of the mercenaries harassing Jacobstown.
Come to a peaceful arrangement with the mercenaries.
(Optional) Wipe the mercenaries out.
Ask Marcus for money to pay off the mercenaries.
Return to Marcus

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Unfriendly Persuasion
Speak with Marcus at the gate to Jacobstown after entering and exiting the lodge at least once.
Deal with Norton and his mercenaries.
Attack and kill them.
Pass a 65 Speech skill check or; Idolized NCR reputation check to convince them to leave.
Talk to Marcus to get an additional 2,000, 2,500 or 3,000 caps to pay them off
Return to Marcus.
Reward: 250 XP; NCR infamy
Reward: 350 XP
Reward: 250 XP + 2,000/2,500 caps; OR; Karma loss + 3,000 caps

notes: If resolved peacefully, Norton and the mercenaries will make their way to a campfire at the north end of Highway 95, west of the Brooks tumbleweed ranch.
Killing them may incur NCR infamy.
Although they are flagged NCR, they will not fight with the Legion if there is a Legion ambush waiting for the player at the road junction, even if the player engages the Legion.

name: Useless Baubles or Fancy Trinkets?
reward_text: 2,000 caps per snow globe (maximum 14,000); Delivered snow globes displayed in presidential suite

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: Useless Baubles or Fancy Trinkets?
Enter the Lucky 38 during The House Always Wins and speak with the securitron, Jane in the penthouse;; ask about Mr. House's collection of snow globes
Find and retrieve the 7 snow globes from locations around the Mojave Wasteland (see below), then bring them to Jane.
Reward: 2,000 caps per snow globe (maximum 14,000); Delivered snow globes displayed in presidential suite

notes: After the player character has returned seven snow globes from the Mojave Wasteland, the snow globe stand will "sparkle" for a moment.

If Mr. House is killed (either independently or as part of a non-House faction quest), Jane will disappear from the penthouse and it will no longer be possible to remove the snow globes from the inventory. However, PC users can use the console command to spawn Jane to their location to continue adding snow globes to the stand. Should Jane still be aggressive after spawning, use the console command after having talked to her to stop all combat.

name: Veni, Vidi, Vici
reward_text: General Oliver's uniform (optional); Achievement/trophy; Game completion

stages.description: Cross the dam and make your way to the western power plant.
(Optional) Take out the snipers who've taken up position in the western portion of the dam.
(Optional) Release the waiting Legion reinforcements inside the intake tower.
Find the enemy commander, General Oliver.
Kill General Oliver and the soldiers guarding him.
Return to the Legate and tell him that General Oliver has been driven off.
Return to the Legate and tell him that General Oliver has been killed.

walkthrough.text: Main Quest: Veni, Vidi, Vici
Reach the interior of the Hoover Dam power plant, section 04.
(Optional) Take out the NCR snipers along the dam.
(Optional) Release the trapped legionnaires inside the intake tower.
Locate General Oliver in his compound.
Fight and kill General Oliver.
Pass a 100 Speech skill check to convince Oliver to retreat.
Speak with Legate Lanius in the power plant.
XP; Achievement/trophy; Game completion

name: Volare!
reward_text: 500 XP; Boomer flightsuit; Boomers helmet; The Boomers will appear during the Second Battle of Hoover Dam

stages.description: Help the Boomers around Nellis.
Return to Pearl.
Speak to Loyal about the Boomer's plan to raise the bomber from the bottom of Lake Mead.
Attach the ballast from Loyal to the B-29 at the bottom of Lake Mead.
(Optional) Talk to Jack about getting a rebreather to swim to the bottom of Lake Mead.
[Optional] Jack needs some parts from a pressure cooker to finish his rebreather.
Return to the shore near the tow winch and use Loyal's detonator to float the B-29 to the surface.
Return to Loyal to let him know the B-29 is up from the bottom of the lake.
Let Pearl know your job is done

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Volare!
Reach Nellis Air Force Base and follow Raquel to speak with Pearl;; agree to assist the Boomers with various problems.
Complete side quests and unmarked quests around Nellis AFB; until achieving 40+ reputation with the Boomers. (Liked to Idolized)
Return to Pearl.
Speak with Loyal about the "lady in the lake";; agree to complete the plan to raise the aircraft from the bottom of Lake Mead.
(Optional) Speak with Jack and either obtain a pressure cooker or; pass a 45 Science skill check to acquire the rebreather.
Locate the crashed B-29 on the bottom of Lake Mead; and interact with the highlighted areas to place the ballasts.
Go to the marked spot near Callville Bay; and equip Loyal's detonator, then "shoot" it to raise the aircraft.
Return to Nellis AFB and speak with Loyal, followed by Pearl.
Reward: 500 XP; Boomer flightsuit & Boomers helmet; Boomers fame; The Boomers will appear during the Second Battle of Hoover Dam.

notes: Killing Pearl at any time fails the quest, and immediately drops reputation with the Boomers to "Hated."
Completing this quest before starting No Gods, No Masters will unlock a dialogue option to bluff General Oliver into backing down, with the threat of the Boomers bombing the dam.
Going underwater with the rebreather poses no threat to any companions (they stay on the surface).
Loyal's detonator is required to raise the B-29, no other detonator will work.
Rocket souvenirs or dino toys can no longer be given to the Mini Boomers once this quest is completed.
Mr. New Vegas will indirectly mention the B-29 on Radio New Vegas on two occasions after completing the quest.(Mr. New Vegas' dialogue)(Mr. New Vegas' dialogue)

Talking to Pete is a fast way to advance this quest, as a good amount of fame - enough to take the player character from Neutral to Accepted - can be gained simply from listening to the story of the Boomers and then exhausting all the dialogue options with him afterward. Every dialogue option has a skill check, which can be passed for additional fame each time.

rules.note: Boomers reputation drops to Hated

rules.when: completed before No Gods, No Masters
rules.note: Threaten to have the Boomers bomb the dam

name: Wang Dang Atomic Tango
reward_text: 450 XP; 150-400 caps (depending on skill checks); Freeside fame

stages.description: Recruit a sexbot.
The sexbot was destroyed.
Tell James Garret Fisto will be joining the Wrangler.
Recruit a suave talker.
The suitable suave talkers are dead.
Tell James Garret Santiago will be joining the Wrangler.
Tell James Garret Old Ben will be joining the Wrangler.
Recruit a real ghoul cowboy.
The ghoul cowboy is dead.
Tell James Garret Beatrix will be joining the Wrangler.
Return to James Garret.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: Wang Dang Atomic Tango
Reach the Atomic Wrangler Casino in Freeside and speak with James Garret;; ask about work needing to be done.
Find and recruit the three requested types of "entertainer" for the Wrangler around Freeside;; pass a 40 Speech/Barter skill check to negotiate increased payment per recruit.
Recruit a ghoul cowboy.
Recruit a suave talker.
Recruit a sexbot.
Speak with Beatrix Russell at the Old Mormon Fort.
Speak with Old Ben near The Strip North Gate or; Santiago near Mick & Ralph's.
Locate Fisto in Cerulean Robotics near the train station.
Pass a 35 Speech/Barter check or; obtain a bottle of absinthe to recruit Beatrix.
Recruit Old Ben: Pass a 50 Speech check or use the Black Widow/Confirmed Bachelor perk.Recruit Santiago: Choose passive dialogue options.
Pass a 60 Science skill check or; acquire the sexbot holodisk from Ralph at Mick & Ralph's to reprogram Fisto.
Return to James.
Reward: 450 XP; 150-400 caps (depending on skill checks); Freeside fame

notes: Completing this quest as well as Debt Collector for Francine will unlock a unique dialogue option when helping Hadrian get out of his contract with the Garrets in order to work for Tommy Torini at the Aces during Talent Pool, where one will leverage the work they already did for the Garrets to convince James to let him go.

If one has a negative reputation with Freeside, it will not be possible to recruit Fisto via getting the holodisk, as Ralph will refuse to initiate dialogue thus it won't be possible to acquire it. This can be circumvented by either passing the 60 Science check or talking with James to restore/raise one's Freeside reputation.
After completing the quest, the player character may enlist the services of the newly recruited escorts (except for Old Ben).
After recruiting them, there is no need to protect or follow the acquired escorts back to the Wrangler; they will arrive without being harmed.

Upon informing James that one has found the ghoul cowboy, and telling him the ghoul is actually a woman, James reveals that the customer's request was for a male ghoul cowboy. Despite fitting perfectly into the desired characteristics, especially if during his companion quest Old School Ghoul he was convinced to wear his vaquero outfit, there is no mention of, nor option to offer up Raul for the escort job.

name: We Are Legion
reward_text: 300 Experience Points; Liberator; Legion fame

stages.description: Kill all NCR Officers at Camp Forlorn Hope.
Return to Dead Sea and inform him of your victory.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: We Are Legion
Speak with Dead Sea in the barracks at Nelson.
Reach Camp Forlorn Hope and eliminate the 4 marked targets:; Maj. Polatli, Quartermaster Mayes, Sergeant Reyes, and Dr. Alex Richards
Return to Dead Sea.
Reward: 300 Experience Points; Liberator; Legion fame

notes: Completing this quest unlocks a unique interaction with Papa Khan of the Great Khans at Red Rock Canyon, where speaking with him afterward will lead to him naming the Courier his successor as chieftain. Silently killing him after this exchange results in attaining leadership of the Khans, which one can use to send the Khans to support the NCR during For the Republic, Part 2.

Completing the NCR side quest Back in Your Own Backyard by rescuing the NCR troopers or mercy-killing them makes Dead Sea permanently hostile toward the player, preventing this quest from being completed.
Completing this quest does not create a Legion presence at Camp Forlorn Hope and NCR forces will continue to spawn at the location for the rest of the game.
Completing this quest by killing Maj. Polatli will fail the NCR side quest No, Not Much but will not fail Bitter Springs Infirmary Blues, although it does inhibit the quest from being started.

rules.note: Bitter Springs Infirmary Blues cannot start but is not failed

rules.when: completed for Dead Sea at Nelson

rules.note: Papa Khan names the Courier his successor; silently killing him gives Khan leadership

name: We Must Stop Beating Like This
source: We Must Stop Beating Like This
reward_text: Unique interaction with Victor

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: We Must Stop Beating Like This
After completing Ain't That a Kick in the Head and before entering the Strip, enter combat near Goodsprings.
Speak with Victor.
Reward: Unique interaction with Victor

notes: Victor may frequently use his grenade launcher for combat. Since Victor only appears when the player character has ≤50% HP, the grenades could sometimes damage and/or kill the player character as well.

Victor will never spawn during combat with the Powder Gangers in Ghost Town Gunfight or with the geckos at Goodsprings source during Back in the Saddle; this is explicitly scripted by the quest so as not to happen.

Victor can and will spawn during Barton the Fink, whether during combat against the geckoes or during the ambush by Barton Thorn. Otherwise, the encounter is likely to occur during They Went That-a-Way.

If Victor was killed during this encounter, when meeting him again at relevant locations during They Went That-a-Way and/or We Must Stop Meeting Like This, there will be a unique dialogue option to comment on his previous "death."Victor: "Do I look destroyed, pardner? It's harder to put {{Tooltip|Old|{Ol} }} Vic in Boot Hill than you might think! I wouldn't be much use stuck inside just one Securitron! No, if the one I'm in turns up a goner, I just find another, fine as cream gravy!"; (Victor's dialogue)

name: We Must Stop Meeting Like This
source: We Must Stop Meeting Like This
reward_text: None

walkthrough.text: Unmarked Quest: We Must Stop Meeting Like This

After completing Ain't That a Kick in the Head and before entering the Lucky 38, speak with Victor as he appears in Goodsprings, Novac, Boulder City and the Strip during They Went That-a-Way and Ring-a-Ding-Ding!
Leads to: The House Always Wins

notes: After the final conversation on the Strip, Victor will disappear from the other locations in the Mojave Wasteland, only appearing outside and inside the Lucky 38 of which the latter has him as a required interaction to use the elevator (unless House is killed and The House Has Gone Bust! is failed which causes him to disappear from there as well).

It is possible to talk to the version of Victor right in front of the door to the Lucky 38 before talking to the version that spawns when entering the Strip for the first time. In this case, after exiting conversation with the doorman robot, the robot on the street will immediately start the dialogue to welcome their arrival to the Strip.

name: We Will All Go Together
reward_text: Turn in 1 dogtag:; 25 caps; 25 XPTurn in all dogtags (10):; 100 XP; 250 caps; Service rifle; 18 5.56 rounds

stages.description: Collect Dog Tags from ghoul NCR troopers within Camp Searchlight and take them to First Sergeant Astor.
All ghoul dog tags found, return to First Sergeant Astor.

walkthrough.text: Side Quest: We Will All Go Together
Speak with First Sergeant Astor near Camp Searchlight;; ask about the fate of the town, followed by the ghoulified troopers.
Collect a total of 10 irradiated NCR dogtags from the ghoulified NCR troopers in and around Camp Searchlight;; pass a 50 Speech skill check to negotiate a better reward for getting the dogtags.
Find Private Kyle Edwards in his home and acquire his dogtag.
Attack and kill Edwards or; pass a 50 Speech check to convince him to attack Astor.
Pass a 60 Speech skill check or 7 Strength attribute check to persuade/intimidate Edwards to hand over his dogtag.

Deal with the radscorpions outside the home, then pass a 50 Speech check / 7 Intelligence check to convince Astor to let Edwards join his squad or; learn from Astor about Ranger Station Echo, then tell Edwards to get his dogtag.
Return to Astor to turn in the 10 dogtags.
Turn in 1 dogtag: 25 caps + 25 XP; Turn in all dogtags (10): 100 XP + 250 caps + Service rifle + 18 5.56 rounds; NCR fame

notes: It is possible for one or more of the ghoul troopers carrying irradiated dogtags to wander outside of Camp Searchlight, including to the north of town, where they may get killed by First Sergeant Astor and his soldiers on patrol.

If Private Edwards is helped to join Astor's squad, Edwards will not follow the group on their patrols and instead he will remain at the tent west of Searchlight; he will defend against a random patrol of Caesar's Legion that sometimes re-spawn either on the road, or behind the tent at Camp Searchlight.

The general vicinity east of Camp Searchlight is patrolled by re-spawning feral ghoul NCR troopers of various types as far north as the Coyote Mines to as far south as the outskirts of the Searchlight Airport. These ghouls do not carry dogtags, but roam nearby enough that they may register on the compass.

If stated that "there are plenty of places out in the wasteland" when Pvt. Edwards asks for suggestions on where to go, he will travel to the Mesquite Mountains camp site, which is ironically inhabited by several types of radscorpions, and the area is irradiated as well.
